title.zh: 卷19 本紀十九 宣宗本紀三
title.raw: 卷19 本紀十九 宣宗本紀三

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月己丑，英人寇廣東虎門，副將陳連陛及其子舉鵬死之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, day jichou, the English attacked Guangdong's Humen; Vice Commander Chen Lianbi and his son Ju Peng died.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 21, month 1, jichou, the British struck Humen in Guangdong; Chen Lianbi and his son Ju Peng were killed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以奕山為御前大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Yishan was made an imperial presence grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Yishan became an imperial presence grand minister.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，琦善以虎門陷，下部嚴議，褫提督關天培頂戴。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, because Humen had fallen Qishan was referred to the ministries for severe deliberation, and Naval Commander Guan Tianpei's peacock feather was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, after Humen fell Qishan faced severe board review and Guan Tianpei lost his peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 命奕山為靖逆將軍，隆文、楊芳為參贊大臣，督辦廣東海防。

translations.literal: Yishan was ordered to be Pacification-of-Rebellion General, with Long Wen and Yang Fang as staff commissioners to supervise Guangdong coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yishan was made Pacification General with Long Wen and Yang Fang as commissioners for Guangdong coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 命賽尚阿在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Saishang'a was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命訥爾經額駐天津，督辦海防。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Ne'erjing'e was ordered to remain at Tianjin and supervise coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Ne'erjing'e was posted at Tianjin to supervise coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 命哈哴阿赴山海關，督辦海防。

translations.literal: Hala'a was ordered to proceed to Shanhaiguan and supervise coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: Hala'a was sent to Shanhaiguan to supervise coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 命耆英等勤哨探。

translations.literal: Qiying and others were ordered to keep scouting patrols diligent.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying and others were told to keep scouts active.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命伊里布回兩江總督任，以裕謙為欽差大臣，辦浙江軍務。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Yilibu was ordered to return to his Liang-Jiang governor-general post; Yuqian was made Imperial Commissioner to handle Zhejiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Yilibu went back to Liang-Jiang and Yuqian became Imperial Commissioner for Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，琦善褫大學士，仍下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Qishan was stripped of grand secretary rank and again referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Qishan lost grand secretary rank and again faced severe board review.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑奉天白旗堡水災旗戶。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to banner households at Fengtian's Baiqibao for flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fengtian's Baiqibao banner households received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇江都、丹徒二縣水災倉穀，奉天小黑山站丁，江蘇廟灣場灶丁，安徽東流、繁昌二縣水旱災口糧。

translations.literal: Granary grain was issued for flood disaster to Jiangdu and Dantu counties, Jiangsu; Fengtian's Xiaoheishan station households; Jiangsu's Miaowan saltern households; and Dongliu and Fanchang counties, Anhui, for flood-and-drought ration grain.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdu and Dantu, Xiaoheishan stationers, Miaowan saltern workers, and Dongliu and Fanchang received disaster grain.

sentences.zh: 貸湖北沔陽等八州縣衛、湖南武陵縣、甘肅金州等五州廳縣水災籽種，江蘇上元等十一縣、甘肅皋蘭縣水災口糧，山西河曲縣雹災倉穀。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned for flood disaster to eight Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Mianyang, Wuling county in Hunan, and five Gansu prefectures and counties including Jinzhou; ration grain was loaned for flood disaster to eleven Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan and Gaolan county, Gansu; and granary grain was issued for hail disaster at Hequ county, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Flood seed loans went to Mianyang and seven other Hubei units, Wuling, five Gansu districts, Shangyuan and ten other Jiangsu counties, and Gaolan; Hequ received hail granary grain.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，以伊里布遷延不進，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: because Yilibu delayed and did not advance, he was referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, gengshen, Yilibu was sent for severe review for delaying his advance.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，琦善逮問，仍籍其家。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Qishan was arrested for interrogation and his household property was again confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Qishan was arrested and his property was confiscated again.

sentences.zh: 以祁為兩廣總督，怡良兼署，李振祜署刑部尚書，授訥爾經額直隸總督，恩特亨額陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Qi was made Liang-Guang governor-general, with Yiliang acting concurrently; Li Zhenfu acted as Minister of Punishments; Ne'erjing'e was appointed Zhili governor-general; and Enteheng'e was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Qi took Liang-Guang with Yiliang acting; Li Zhenfu acted at Punishments; Ne'erjing'e took Zhili; Enteheng'e took Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，越南國王阮福皎卒，詔停貢方物。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Vietnam's King Ruan Fuciao died; tribute goods were ordered suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Vietnam's King Ruan Fuciao died and tribute was suspended.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，英人去定海，以伊里布庸懦，褫協辦大學士，留兩江總督任。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, because the English had left Dinghai, Yilibu was stripped of associate grand secretary rank for cowardice but kept the Liang-Jiang governor-general post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, with the British gone from Dinghai, Yilibu lost associate grand secretary rank for cowardice but kept Liang-Jiang.

sentences.zh: 命寶興為大學士，仍留四川總督。

translations.literal: Baoxing was made grand secretary while remaining Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing became grand secretary and stayed at Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 以奕經協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Yijing was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命齊慎為參贊大臣，赴廣東會剿。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Qi Shen was ordered to be staff commissioner and proceed to Guangdong for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Qi Shen was sent to Guangdong as staff commissioner for joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 壬午，英人陷廣東虎門砲台及烏涌卡座，廣東水師提督關天培、署湖南提督祥福等死之。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the English took Guangdong's Humen batteries and the Wuyong barrier post; Guangdong naval commander Guan Tianpei, acting Hunan commander Xiang Fu, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the British took Humen batteries and Wuyong; Guan Tianpei, Xiang Fu, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，展賑江蘇江寧、通州二府州災民。

translations.literal: That month, extended relief was given to disaster victims in Jiangsu's Jiangning and Tongzhou prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiangning and Tongzhou received extended disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，釋周天爵赴廣東軍營。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day bingxu: Zhou Tianjue was released to proceed to the Guangdong army camp.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, bingxu new moon, Zhou Tianjue was freed to go to the Guangdong camp.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted three-tenths of quota levies on places the route passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and cut route taxes by thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 乙未，致仕大學士文孚卒。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, retired Grand Secretary Wen Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, retired Grand Secretary Wen Fu died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，英人兵船入廣東內港，楊芳等擊走之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, English warships entered Guangdong's inner harbor; Yang Fang and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, British ships entered Guangdong's inner harbor and Yang Fang drove them off.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵，至龍泉峪孝穆皇后、孝慎皇后、孝全皇后陵寢奠酒。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling, and at Longquan Valley offered libation at the tomb palaces of Empresses Xiaomu, Xiaoshen, and Xiaoquan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling and offered at Longquan Valley to Empresses Xiaomu, Xiaoshen, and Xiaoquan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上再謁昌陵，行敷土禮。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor again visited Changling and performed the earth-spreading rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor again visited Changling and performed the earth-spreading rite.

sentences.zh: 詣隆恩殿行大饗禮。

translations.literal: He went to Long'en Hall and performed the great feast rite.
translations.idiomatic: At Long'en Hall he held the great feast rite.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上臨故大學士文孚第賜奠。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor went in person to the late Grand Secretary Wen Fu's residence to grant mourning gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor mourned at Wen Fu's house.

sentences.zh: 戊申，准米里堅等國通商。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Meilijian and other states were permitted to trade.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, America and other countries were allowed to trade.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以裕謙奏，命沿海通商口岸照舊准商民貿易。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, because Yuqian memorialized, coastal treaty ports were ordered to allow merchants to trade as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Yuqian's memorial reopened coastal treaty ports to merchant trade.

sentences.zh: 壬子，楊芳等請仍准英國商船在廣東貿易。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Yang Fang and others asked that British merchant ships still be allowed to trade at Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Yang Fang and others asked to keep British trade at Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 不許，命將楊芳、怡良嚴議。

translations.literal: It was not permitted; Yang Fang and Yiliang were ordered referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused and sent Yang Fang and Yiliang for severe review.

sentences.zh: 閏三月乙卯朔，褫楊芳、怡良職，仍留任。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, new moon on day yimao: Yang Fang and Yiliang were stripped of office but kept in post.
translations.idiomatic: At intercalary month 3, yimao new moon, Yang Fang and Yiliang lost rank but stayed on.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，湯金釗降調，調卓秉恬為吏部尚書、協辦大學士，祁俊藻為戶部尚書，以許乃普為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Tang Jinzhao was demoted and transferred; Zhuo Bingtian was transferred to be Minister of Personnel and associate grand secretary; Qi Junzao was made Minister of Revenue; and Xu Naipu was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Tang Jinzhao was demoted; Zhuo Bingtian took Personnel and became associate grand secretary; Qi Junzao took Revenue; Xu Naipu took War.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召伊里布來京，以裕謙為兩江總督，命定海防務交劉韻珂辦理。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Yilibu was summoned to the capital; Yuqian was made Liang-Jiang governor-general; and Dinghai coastal defense was ordered handed to Liu Yunke.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yilibu was called to Beijing; Yuqian took Liang-Jiang; Liu Yunke took Dinghai defense.

sentences.zh: 調梁章鉅為江蘇巡撫，以周之琦為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Liang Zhangju was transferred to be Jiangsu governor, and Zhou Zhiqi was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Zhangju took Jiangsu and Zhou Zhiqi took Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，諭奕山等撫恤各國洋商。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yishan and others were instructed to comfort and relieve foreign merchants of all nations.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yishan and others were told to soothe foreign merchants.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西吉州等十州縣暨和林格爾廳上年歉收倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for last year's poor harvest to ten Shanxi prefectures and counties including Jizhou and Horinger banner.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jizhou and nine other Shanxi districts and Horinger received poor-harvest granary loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇宿遷縣被水灘租。

translations.literal: Flood-stricken beach rents at Suqian county, Jiangsu, were remitted or deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Suqian's flooded beach rents were remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，命裕謙仍為欽差大臣，督辦浙江海防。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jichou: Yuqian was again ordered to be Imperial Commissioner to supervise Zhejiang coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, jichou, Yuqian again became Imperial Commissioner for Zhejiang coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 英人陷廣東城外砲台。

translations.literal: The English took the batteries outside Guangdong's provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: The British took Guangzhou's outer batteries.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，禮部尚書奎照病免，以色克精額為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Minister of Rites Kuizhao left office on illness; Sekejin'e was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Kuizhao retired ill and Sekejin'e took Rites.

sentences.zh: 賜龍啟瑞等二百二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Two hundred two men including Long Qirui were granted metropolitan graduate degrees with rank differences.
translations.idiomatic: 202 men including Long Qirui received jinshi degrees with differing ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命睿親王等、大學士、軍機大臣、各部尚書會同刑部訊伊里布。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Prince of Rui and others, grand secretaries, Grand Councilors, and ministers of the boards were ordered to join the Ministry of Punishments in interrogating Yilibu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, princes, grand secretaries, councilors, and ministers joined Punishments to try Yilibu.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以廣東省城圍急，准奕山等奏，令英人通商。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because the siege of Guangdong's provincial city was urgent, Yishan and others were permitted by memorial to allow the English to trade.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, with Guangzhou besieged, Yishan's memorial opened trade to the British.

sentences.zh: 是月，緩徵山西朔州等六州廳縣逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue levies were deferred for six Shanxi prefectures and counties including Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shuozhou and five other Shanxi districts had overdue levies deferred.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，英船入浙洋，命裕謙申嚴各海口兵備。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: English ships entered Zhejiang waters; Yuqian was ordered to tighten naval defenses at every port.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingchen, British ships entered Zhejiang waters and Yuqian was told to tighten every port.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，鄧廷楨、林則徐遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Deng Tingzhen and Lin Zexu were banished to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Deng Tingzhen and Lin Zexu were exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，英船去廣東虎門。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, English ships left Guangdong's Humen.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, British ships left Humen.

sentences.zh: 穆彰阿免管理籓院，命賽尚阿代之。

translations.literal: Muzhang'a was removed from managing the Court of Colonial Affairs; Saishang'a was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhang'a left colonial affairs management and Saishang'a replaced him.

sentences.zh: 參贊大臣、戶部尚書隆文卒于軍。

translations.literal: Staff Commissioner and Minister of Revenue Long Wen died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: Staff Commissioner and Revenue Minister Long Wen died in the field.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，調敬徵為戶部尚書，賽尚阿為工部尚書，恩桂為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Jingzheng was transferred to be Minister of Revenue; Saishang'a Minister of Works; and En Gui Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Jingzheng took Revenue, Saishang'a Works, and En Gui colonial affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，調吳文鎔為江西巡撫，錢寶琛為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Wu Wenrong was transferred to be Jiangxi governor and Qian Baochen Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Wu Wenrong took Jiangxi and Qian Baochen Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以奕興為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Yixing was made Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing became Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 六月，准祁等奏定商船赴天津等處章程。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Qi and others' memorial fixing regulations for merchant ships proceeding to Tianjin and other places was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, Qi's regulations for merchant ships to Tianjin and elsewhere were approved.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，褫伊里布職，發軍台效力贖罪。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Yilibu was stripped of office and sent to military courier stations to redeem guilt through service.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Yilibu lost office and was sent to courier stations to redeem his guilt.

sentences.zh: 准奕山等奏，分期撤兵。

translations.literal: Yishan and others' memorial to withdraw troops by stages was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yishan's staged troop withdrawal was approved.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，琦善論斬。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Qishan was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Qishan was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，河南下南廳河決。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Henan Xiaonan Office river breached.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Henan Xiaonan Office river broke.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，褫文沖職，仍留河東河道總督任，牛鑒下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Wen Chong was stripped of office but kept the Grand Canal-East transport governor-general post; Niu Jian was referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Wen Chong lost rank but kept canal-east transport; Niu Jian faced severe review.

sentences.zh: 七月丙辰，命王鼎等赴東河督工。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingchen: Wang Ding and others were ordered to proceed to the Eastern River to supervise works.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, bingchen, Wang Ding and others were sent to supervise Eastern River works.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以李振祜為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Li Zhenfu was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Li Zhenfu took Punishments.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以達賴喇嘛於四月坐床，頒敕書。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, because the Dalai Lama had been enthroned in the fourth month, an imperial patent was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, after the Dalai Lama's fourth-month enthronement, an imperial patent was issued.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命前寧夏將軍特依順為參贊大臣，赴廣東。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, former Ningxia general Te Yishun was made staff commissioner and ordered to proceed to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, former Ningxia general Te Yishun was sent to Guangdong as staff commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以河水汎濫，命牛鑒移民賑恤。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, because the river had overflowed, Niu Jian was ordered to move the people and give disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, with the river in flood, Niu Jian was ordered to relocate people and relieve disaster.

sentences.zh: 己卯，南掌入貢。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Lan Xang presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Lan Xang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，英人陷福建廈門，總兵江繼芸等死之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the English took Fujian's Xiamen; Regional Commander Jiang Jiyun and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the British took Xiamen; Jiang Jiyun and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 以故越南國王阮福皎子阮福暶為越南國王，命廣西按察使寶清往冊封。

translations.literal: The late Vietnam King Ruan Fuciao's son Ruan Fuxuan was made King of Vietnam; Guangxi surveillance commissioner Bao Qing was ordered to proceed to invest him.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Fuxuan succeeded his father as Vietnam's king and Bao Qing was sent to invest him.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，以桂輪為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiwei: Gui Lun was made Rehe commander.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, guiwei, Gui Lun became Rehe commander.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，英人寇浙江。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the English attacked Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the British attacked Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以硃襄為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Zhu Xiang was made Grand Canal-East transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Zhu Xiang became canal-east transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，萬壽節，上詣皇太后宮行禮。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, longevity festival: the Emperor went to the Empress Dowager's palace to perform rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, longevity day, the Emperor paid respects at the Empress Dowager's palace.

sentences.zh: 御正大光明殿，皇子及王以下文武大臣，蒙古使臣、外籓王公行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: At the Hall of Supreme Harmony, princes and civil and military officials, Mongol envoys, and foreign tributary princes performed congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of Supreme Harmony princes, officials, Mongol envoys, and foreign princes congratulated.

sentences.zh: 褫文沖職，枷號河干。

translations.literal: Wen Chong was stripped of office and cangued at the river bank.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Chong lost office and wore the cangue at the riverbank.

sentences.zh: 以王鼎署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Wang Ding was ordered to act as Grand Canal-East transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ding acted as canal-east transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 英人去廈門。

translations.literal: The English left Xiamen.
translations.idiomatic: The British left Xiamen.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，英人寇浙江雙澳、石浦等處，裕謙督兵擊走之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the English attacked Shuang'ao, Shipu, and other places in Zhejiang; Yuqian supervised troops and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the British hit Shuang'ao and Shipu in Zhejiang and Yuqian drove them off.

sentences.zh: 命怡良赴福建查辦軍務。

translations.literal: Yiliang was ordered to proceed to Fujian to investigate military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang was sent to Fujian to investigate military affairs.

sentences.zh: 以梁寶常署廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Liang Baochang was ordered to act as Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Baochang acted as Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以趙炳言為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zhao Bingyan was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zhao Bingyan became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，英人復大舉寇浙江。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the English again attacked Zhejiang on a large scale.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the British again invaded Zhejiang in force.

sentences.zh: 戊申，英人再陷定海，總兵王錫朋、鄭國鴻、葛雲飛等死之。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the English again took Dinghai; Regional Commander Wang Xipeng, Zheng Guohong, Ge Yunfei, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the British retook Dinghai; Wang Xipeng, Zheng Guohong, Ge Yunfei, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 裕謙、餘步雲下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Yuqian and Yu Buyun were referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Yuqian and Yu Buyun faced severe board review.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西華州、大荔二州縣，河南睢州等八州廳縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota levies were remitted for flood disaster at Huazhou and Daliji prefectures, Shaanxi, and eight Henan prefectures and counties including Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huazhou, Daliji, and eight Henan districts including Suizhou had flood taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，英人陷鎮海，欽差大臣裕謙死之，提督餘步雲遁。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao: the English took Zhenhai; Imperial Commissioner Yuqian died, and Commander Yu Buyun fled.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, yimao, the British took Zhenhai; Yuqian was killed and Yu Buyun fled.

sentences.zh: 命奕經為揚威將軍，哈哴阿、胡超為參贊大臣，督辦浙江海防。

translations.literal: Yijing was ordered to be Displaying-Might General, with Hala'a and Hu Chao as staff commissioners to supervise Zhejiang coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing became Displaying-Might General with Hala'a and Hu Chao as commissioners for Zhejiang defense.

sentences.zh: 命怡良為欽差大臣，會同顏伯燾、劉鴻翱督辦浙江海防。

translations.literal: Yiliang was made Imperial Commissioner to join Yan Bozhao and Liu Hong'ao in supervising Zhejiang coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang became Imperial Commissioner with Yan Bozhao and Liu Hong'ao for Zhejiang defense.

sentences.zh: 以牛鑒署兩江總督，鄂順安署河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Niu Jian was ordered to act as Liang-Jiang governor-general, and E Shun'an to act as Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Jian acted at Liang-Jiang and E Shun'an at Henan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命文蔚為參贊大臣，赴浙江，胡超仍駐天津。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Wen Wei was ordered to be staff commissioner and proceed to Zhejiang; Hu Chao remained stationed at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Wen Wei was sent to Zhejiang as staff commissioner; Hu Chao stayed at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 命特依順為參贊大臣，赴浙江，哈哴阿仍駐山海關。

translations.literal: Te Yishun was ordered to be staff commissioner and proceed to Zhejiang; Hala'a remained stationed at Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: Te Yishun was sent to Zhejiang as staff commissioner; Hala'a stayed at Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 命祁俊藻在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Qi Junzao was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Junzao joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 授牛鑒兩江總督。

translations.literal: Niu Jian was appointed Liang-Jiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Jian became Liang-Jiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，英人陷浙江寧波府。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the English took Zhejiang's Ningbo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the British took Ningbo prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor reviewed Firearms Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Emperor reviewed Firearms Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑奉天遼陽等六州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for flood disaster to six Fengtian prefectures and counties including Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liaoyang and five other Fengtian districts received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，命僧格林沁等巡視天津海口。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuzi: Senggelinqin and others were ordered to inspect the Tianjin river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, wuzi, Senggelinqin and others were sent to inspect Tianjin's river mouth.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，英船入台灣海口，達洪阿等擊退之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, English ships entered Taiwan's harbor mouth; Da Hong'a and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, British ships entered Taiwan's harbor and Da Hong'a drove them off.

sentences.zh: 命王得祿赴台灣協剿。

translations.literal: Wang Delu was ordered to proceed to Taiwan for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Delu was sent to Taiwan for joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑湖南華容縣、岳州衛，江西德化等十縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster relief was given to Hunan's Huarong county and Yuezhou Guard, and ten Jiangxi counties including Dehua.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huarong and Yuezhou and ten Jiangxi counties including Dehua received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 加賑湖北沔陽等九州縣、山西薩拉齊廳災民、江蘇上元等十五縣衛災民，並免額賦。

translations.literal: Additional relief was given to disaster victims in nine Hubei prefectures and counties including Mianyang, Shanxi's Saragel Office, and fifteen Jiangsu counties and guards including Shangyuan; quota levies were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Extra relief went to Mianyang and eight other Hubei units, Saragel, and fifteen Jiangsu counties and guards including Shangyuan, with quota levies remitted.

sentences.zh: 給安徽無為等十二州縣水災口糧屋費，並免額賦。

translations.literal: Ration grain and housing funds were issued for flood disaster to twelve Anhui prefectures and counties including Wuwei; quota levies were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wuwei and eleven other Anhui districts received flood rations and housing funds, with quota levies remitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，以程矞采署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengwu: Cheng Yucai was ordered to act as Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, gengwu, Cheng Yucai acted as Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 以青海玉樹番族雪災，免應徵銀二年。

translations.literal: Because of snow disaster among Qinghai's Yushu tribes, levied silver was remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: Yushu tribes' snow disaster brought a two-year remission of levied silver.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，英人陷浙江餘姚縣，復入慈谿。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the English took Zhejiang's Yuyao county and again entered Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the British took Yuyao and re-entered Cixi.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇上元、江寧二縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in Jiangsu's Shangyuan and Jiangning counties received relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shangyuan and Jiangning received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，褫顏伯燾職，以楊國楨為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi: Yan Bozhao was stripped of office; Yang Guozhen was made Min-Zhe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, wuzi, Yan Bozhao lost office and Yang Guozhen became Min-Zhe governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以梁萼涵為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Liang Ehan was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Liang Ehan became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，英人陷浙江奉化縣。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the English took Zhejiang's Fenghua county.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the British took Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，湖北崇陽縣匪鍾人傑作亂，攻陷縣城，命裕泰等督兵討之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, bandit Zhong Renjie rebelled in Hubei's Chongyang county and took the county seat; Yu Tai and others were ordered to lead troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Zhong Renjie took Chongyang and Yu Tai was ordered to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 以程矞採為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Cheng Yucai was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yucai became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，英船寇浙江乍浦。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, English ships raided Zhejiang's Zhapu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, British ships raided Zhapu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，英船寇台灣淡水、雞籠，達洪阿等擊退之。

translations.literal: On day wushen, English ships raided Taiwan's Tamsui and Jilong; Da Hong'a and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, British ships hit Tamsui and Jilong and Da Hong'a drove them off.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇新陽縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in Jiangsu's Xinyang county received relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xinyang received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 展賑河南祥符等六縣、江蘇上元等十縣災民。

translations.literal: Extended relief was given to disaster victims in six Henan counties including Xiangfu and ten Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangfu and five other Henan counties and Shangyuan and nine other Jiangsu counties received extended relief.

sentences.zh: 貸河南睢州、柘城縣貧民籽種口糧，並平糶淮寧縣倉穀。

translations.literal: Seed grain and ration loans were given to poor households in Henan's Suizhou and Zhecheng county; Huaining county granary grain was sold at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: Suizhou and Zhecheng poor received seed and ration loans and Huaining granary grain was sold fairly.

sentences.zh: 緩徵江西南昌等二十二縣逋賦，浙江橫浦、浦東二場灶課。

translations.literal: Overdue levies were deferred for twenty-two Jiangxi counties including Nanchang, and saltern duties at Zhejiang's Hengpu and Pudong posts.
translations.idiomatic: Nanchang and twenty-one other Jiangxi counties had overdue levies deferred, with Hengpu and Pudong saltern duties deferred.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、南掌入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Nanzhang paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea, Ryukyu, and Nanzhang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月丙辰，楊國楨病免，以怡良為閩浙總督，梁寶常為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, spring, first month, day bingchen: Yang Guozhen left office on illness; Yiliang was made Min-Zhe governor-general and Liang Baochang Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22, month 1, bingchen, Yang Guozhen retired ill; Yiliang took Min-Zhe and Liang Baochang took Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 甲子，盛京將軍耆英改廣州將軍，以禧恩署之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Mukden General Qiying was transferred to Guangzhou general; Xi'en acted for him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Qiying moved from Mukden to Guangzhou general and Xi'en acted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，湖北崇陽賊匪陷通山，裕泰遣兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Chongyang rebels took Tongshan; Yu Tai sent troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Chongyang rebels took Tongshan and Yu Tai defeated them.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，克復湖北崇陽縣，獲匪首鍾人傑。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Hubei's Chongyang county was recovered and bandit chief Zhong Renjie was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Chongyang was recovered and Zhong Renjie was captured.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽無為等十二州縣衛，奉天遼陽等六處、新民等四廳縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster relief was given to twelve Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Wuwei, six Fengtian districts including Liaoyang, and four offices and counties including Xinmin.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wuwei and eleven other Anhui units, Liaoyang and five other Fengtian districts, and Xinmin and three other counties received relief.

sentences.zh: 給安徽泗州等二十二州縣衛、浙江海寧等七州縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: Flood ration grain was issued to twenty-two Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou, and seven Zhejiang prefectures and counties including Haining.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou and twenty-one other Anhui units and Haining and six other Zhejiang districts received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 貸江西德化等七縣、湖南武陵縣、湖北嘉魚等九縣衛、陝西葭州等五州縣水災籽種口糧，山西薩拉齊廳歉收倉穀，江蘇災區京右等營兵餉。

translations.literal: Flood seed and ration loans were given to seven Jiangxi counties including Dehua, Hunan's Wuling county, nine Hubei counties and guards including Jiayu, five Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou; poor-harvest granary grain at Shanxi's Saragel Office; and pay for troops at Jiangsu disaster-area camps including Jingyou.
translations.idiomatic: Flood seed loans went to Dehua and six other Jiangxi counties, Wuling, Jiayu and eight other Hubei units, five Shaanxi districts including Jiazhou, Saragel granary grain, and Jiangsu disaster-camp pay.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩浙江海寧等九州縣衛水災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies for flood disaster were remitted or deferred at nine Zhejiang prefectures, counties, and guards including Haining.
translations.idiomatic: Haining and eight other Zhejiang districts had flood quota levies remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，命林則徐仍戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu: Lin Zexu was ordered to remain banished at Yili.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, bingxu, Lin Zexu was kept at Yili exile.

sentences.zh: 丙申，奕經等進攻寧波失利。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Yijing and others attacked Ningbo without success.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Yijing's attack on Ningbo failed.

sentences.zh: 釋伊里布赴浙江軍營。

translations.literal: Yilibu was released to proceed to the Zhejiang army camp.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibu was freed to go to the Zhejiang camp.

sentences.zh: 命耆英署杭州將軍。

translations.literal: Qiying was ordered to act as Hangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying acted as Hangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 王鼎乞假。

translations.literal: Wang Ding requested leave.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ding took leave.

sentences.zh: 命齊慎仍為參贊大臣，辦理浙江軍務。

translations.literal: Qi Shen was again ordered to be staff commissioner to handle Zhejiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shen again became staff commissioner for Zhejiang military affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命耆英為欽差大臣，會同特依順守浙江省城，並命劉韻珂會辦防務，責成奕經等守沿海各口岸。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Qiying was made Imperial Commissioner to hold Zhejiang's provincial city jointly with Te Yishun; Liu Yunke was ordered to join coastal defense; Yijing and others were charged to guard every coastal port.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Qiying became Imperial Commissioner to hold Hangzhou with Te Yishun; Liu Yunke joined defense; Yijing was charged to guard every coastal port.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑盛京遼陽等處、江蘇上元等八縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims at Mukden's Liaoyang and elsewhere and eight Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan received relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liaoyang and other Mukden districts and Shangyuan and seven other Jiangsu counties received relief.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Third month, day renzi: the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, renzi, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上行圍，翼日如之。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor went on the hunt enclosure; the next day likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor hunted; the next day as well.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor returned to Yuanming Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor returned to Yuanming Garden.

sentences.zh: 恩特亨額卒，以富呢揚阿為陝甘總督，壁昌為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Enteheng'e died; Funiyang'a was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general and Bichang Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Enteheng'e died; Funiyang'a took Shaanxi-Gansu and Bichang took Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 以慶昌為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Qingchang was made Yili staff commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qingchang became Yili staff commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲緩河南鄭州積澇地畝逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue levies on waterlogged land at Henan's Zhengzhou were remitted or deferred.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhengzhou's waterlogged land had overdue levies remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，英人復寇台灣，達洪阿等擊走之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiwei: the English again raided Taiwan; Da Hong'a and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, guiwei, the British raided Taiwan again and Da Hong'a drove them off.

sentences.zh: 加達洪阿太子太保。

translations.literal: Da Hong'a was given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Da Hong'a received the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 己丑，英人去寧波府。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the English left Ningbo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the British left Ningbo.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上詣黑龍潭神祠祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor went to the Black Dragon Pool shrine to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool shrine.

sentences.zh: 乙未，英人陷浙江乍浦，同知韋逢甲死之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the English took Zhejiang's Zhapu; Subprefect Wei Fengjia died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the British took Zhapu and Wei Fengjia was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，褫餘步雲職逮問。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yu Buyun was stripped of office and arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yu Buyun lost office and was arrested.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鍾人傑伏誅。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Zhong Renjie was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Zhong Renjie was executed.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖南鳳凰等五廳縣屯丁苗佃籽種口糧，山西吉州等十四州縣倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, seed and ration loans were given to Hunan's Fenghuang and four other offices and counties for garrison households and Miao tenants; granary grain was loaned to fourteen Shanxi prefectures and counties including Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fenghuang and four other Hunan districts received seed loans for garrison and Miao tenants, and Jizhou and thirteen other Shanxi districts received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 緩徵山西陽曲縣、薩拉齊廳逋穀。

translations.literal: Overdue grain levies were deferred at Shanxi's Yangqu county and Saragel Office.
translations.idiomatic: Yangqu and Saragel had overdue grain levies deferred.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉，大學士王鼎暴卒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiyou: Grand Secretary Wang Ding died suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jiyou, Grand Secretary Wang Ding died suddenly.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，降湯金釗為光祿寺卿。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Tang Jinzhao was demoted to Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Tang Jinzhao was demoted to Court of Imperial Entertainments director.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，湯金釗乞休，允之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Tang Jinzhao requested retirement; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Tang Jinzhao retired.

sentences.zh: 戊午，奕山以查奏不實，褫左都御史，並祁、梁寶常褫職留任。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yishan lost the post of Left Censor-in-chief for false memorials; Qi and Liang Baochang were stripped of office but kept on.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Yishan lost Left Censor-in-chief rank for false memorials; Qi and Liang Baochang lost rank but stayed on.

sentences.zh: 己未，禮部尚書色克精額卒，以恩桂代之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Minister of Rites Sekejin'e died; En Gui replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Sekejin'e died and En Gui took Rites.

sentences.zh: 以吉倫泰為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Jiluntai was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jiluntai became colonial affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 以奎照為左都御史。

translations.literal: Kuizhao was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Kuizhao became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，英人陷江蘇寶山縣，提督陳化成死之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the English took Jiangsu's Baoshan county; Regional Commander Chen Huacheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the British took Baoshan and Chen Huacheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 命耆英、伊里布赴江蘇，會同牛鑒防剿。

translations.literal: Qiying and Yilibu were ordered to Jiangsu to join Niu Jian in coastal defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying and Yilibu were sent to Jiangsu to join Niu Jian in defense.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，英人陷上海縣，典史楊慶恩死之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the English took Shanghai county; Clerk Yang Qing'en died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the British took Shanghai and Yang Qing'en was killed.

sentences.zh: 命賽尚阿為欽差大臣，會同訥爾經額防剿。

translations.literal: Saishang'a was made Imperial Commissioner to join Ne'erjing'e in defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a became Imperial Commissioner with Ne'erjing'e for defense.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江蘇山陽縣及淮安等二縣衛歉收籽種。

translations.literal: That month, poor-harvest seed loans were given to Jiangsu's Shanyang county and two counties and guards at Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shanyang and two Huai'an counties and guards received poor-harvest seed loans.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅朔，日食。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day wuyin: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, wuyin new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩湖北被匪滋擾之崇陽等五縣衛新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for five Hubei counties and guards including Chongyang disturbed by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyang and four other Hubei units disturbed by bandits had quota levies remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以文慶為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Wen Qing was made Urga commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Wen Qing became Urga commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，蠲緩浙江被擾之定海等十二縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: On day renchen, new and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for twelve Zhejiang counties including Dinghai that had been disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Dinghai and eleven other disturbed Zhejiang counties had quota levies remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，英船寇京口。

translations.literal: On day guisi, English ships raided Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, British ships raided Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，英船寇鎮江，齊慎等遁。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, English ships raided Zhenjiang; Qi Shen and others fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, British ships raided Zhenjiang and Qi Shen fled.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，英人陷鎮江，副都統海齡死之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the English took Zhenjiang; Vice Commander-in-chief Hailing died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the British took Zhenjiang and Hailing was killed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，英船寇江寧省城。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiayin: English ships raided Jiangning provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, jiayin, British ships raided Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 命伊里布等議款。

translations.literal: Yilibu and others were ordered to negotiate terms.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibu and others were told to negotiate terms.

sentences.zh: 命奕經進駐常州。

translations.literal: Yijing was ordered to advance and station at Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing was ordered to station at Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，耆英奏與英兵官瑪禮遜等議罷兵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Qiying memorialized that he had discussed ceasefire with British officers including Morrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Qiying reported ceasefire talks with Morrison and other British officers.

sentences.zh: 諭「朕以民命為重」，令妥行定議。

translations.literal: An edict said, "We place the people's lives foremost," and ordered the agreement settled properly.
translations.idiomatic: The court said it put the people first and ordered the agreement settled properly.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，耆英等請與英兵官定約，鈐御寶。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Qiying and others asked to fix a treaty with British officers; the imperial seal was applied.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Qiying asked to seal a treaty with British officers.

sentences.zh: 諭「朕因億萬生靈所系」，允所請。

translations.literal: An edict said, "We act for the countless lives at stake," and granted the request.
translations.idiomatic: The court cited countless lives at stake and granted the request.

sentences.zh: 庚午，江南桃北廳河決。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Jiangnan Taobei Office river breached.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Jiangnan Taobei Office river broke.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑巴里坤地震災。

translations.literal: That month, earthquake disaster relief was given at Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Barkul received earthquake relief.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，耆英奏廣州、福州、廈門、寧波、上海各海口，與英國定議通商。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuyin: Qiying memorialized that at Guangzhou, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Ningbo, and Shanghai treaty ports trade with Britain had been agreed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, wuyin, Qiying reported treaty trade at Guangzhou, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Ningbo, and Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 戊子，麟慶以貽誤河防，褫職留任。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Lin Qing lost office for negligence in river defense but remained in post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Lin Qing lost rank for river negligence but stayed on.

sentences.zh: 命敬徵、廖鴻荃赴江南查勘河工。

translations.literal: Jingzheng and Liao Hongquan were ordered to Jiangnan to survey river works.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzheng and Liao Hongquan were sent to Jiangnan to survey river works.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸巴里坤地震災修屋費。

translations.literal: That month, earthquake rebuilding funds were loaned at Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Barkul received earthquake rebuilding loans.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，沈岐乞終養，允之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei: Shen Qi requested mourning leave to care for a parent; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, dingwei, Shen Qi was granted mourning leave.

sentences.zh: 以李宗昉為左都御史。

translations.literal: Li Zongfang was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongfang became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，授禧恩盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Xi'en was appointed Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Xi'en became Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 戊午，硃樹乞終養，允之。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Zhu Shu requested mourning leave; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Zhu Shu was granted mourning leave.

sentences.zh: 命周天爵以二品頂戴署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianjue was ordered to act as Grand Canal transport governor-general with second-rank hat button.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianjue acted as canal transport governor-general with second-rank button.

sentences.zh: 己未，兩江總督牛鑒褫職逮問，命耆英代之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Liang-Jiang governor-general Niu Jian was stripped and arrested; Qiying replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Niu Jian was stripped and arrested and Qiying took Liang-Jiang.

sentences.zh: 召奕山來京。

translations.literal: Yishan was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yishan was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以伊里布為欽差大臣、廣州將軍，辦理善後事宜。

translations.literal: Yilibu was made Imperial Commissioner and Guangzhou general to handle aftermath affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibu became Imperial Commissioner and Guangzhou general for aftermath affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，河東河道總督硃襄卒，以慧成署之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Grand Canal-East transport governor-general Zhu Xiang died; Huicheng acted for him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Zhu Xiang died and Huicheng acted as canal-east transport.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，召奕經、文蔚來京。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Yijing and Wen Wei were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Yijing and Wen Wei were called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命齊慎回四川提督。

translations.literal: Qi Shen was ordered back to Sichuan as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shen returned to Sichuan as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命伊里布議通商稅課事宜。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Yilibu was ordered to negotiate treaty-port tax matters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Yilibu was told to negotiate treaty-port taxes.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，壁昌遷福州將軍，以李星沅為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Bichang was transferred to Fuzhou general; Li Xingyuan was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Bichang took Fuzhou general and Li Xingyuan took Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，上閱圓明園八旗槍兵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengchen: the Emperor reviewed Eight Banner musketeers at Yuanming Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, gengchen, the Emperor reviewed Yuanming Garden musketeers.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，奕山、奕經、文蔚交刑部治罪，特依順、齊慎下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Yishan, Yijing, and Wen Wei were handed to the Ministry of Punishments for trial; Te Yishun and Qi Shen were referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Yishan, Yijing, and Wen Wei went to Punishments; Te Yishun and Qi Shen faced severe review.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，減免江蘇濱海被兵太倉等四十廳州縣衛新舊額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, new and old quota levies were reduced or remitted by grade for forty Jiangsu coastal offices, prefectures, counties, and guards including Taicang that had suffered war.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Taicang and thirty-nine other war-hit Jiangsu coastal districts had quota levies reduced or remitted by grade.

sentences.zh: 甲午，奕山、奕經、文蔚均奪職論斬，特依順、齊慎褫職留任。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Yishan, Yijing, and Wenwei were all stripped of office and sentenced to execution; Te Yishun and Qi Shen were stripped of office but retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Yishan, Yijing, and Wenwei lost office and were condemned to death; Te Yishun and Qi Shen were demoted but kept on duty.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命戶部尚書敬徵協辦大學士，調恩桂為吏部尚書，以麟魁署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Minister of Revenue Jingzheng was ordered to serve as associate Grand Secretary; Engui was transferred to Minister of Personnel, and Lin Kui acted as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Jingzheng became associate Grand Secretary; Engui took Personnel and Lin Kui acted at Rites.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，慶郡王奕糹采緣事奪爵，不入八分輔國公釂性奪爵發盛京。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Prince Qing Yicai lost his title over an affair; Auxiliary State Duke Jixing, not in the eight banners, lost his title and was sent to Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Prince Qing Yicai was disranked; Jixing, an out-of-eight-banners duke, was disranked and sent to Mukden.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇桃源、沭陽二縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in Taoyuan and Shuyang counties, Jiangsu, was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month Taoyuan and Shuyang in Jiangsu received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給湖北江陵等四縣、山西保德等三州廳縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was given to disaster victims in four Hubei counties including Jiangling and three Shanxi prefectures and counties including Baode.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangling and three other Hubei counties and three Baode-area Shanxi districts received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸奉天牛庄等處災民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was lent to disaster victims at Niuzhuang and other places in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Niuzhuang and other Fengtian places received lent ration grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇海州等五州縣、湖南澧州等八州縣衛新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred for five Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Haizhou and eight Hunan prefectures, counties, and guards including Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Haizhou and four other Jiangsu districts and eight Lizhou-area Hunan districts had taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，召科布多參贊大臣固慶來京，以果勒明阿代之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingwei: Kobdo resident minister Gu Qing was summoned to the capital and Goleminka replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, dingwei, Gu Qing was called to Beijing and Goleminka took Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 召烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣盛貴來京，以樂斌代之。

translations.literal: Urga resident minister Sheng Gui was summoned to the capital and Le Bin replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Gui was called to Beijing and Le Bin replaced him at Urga.

sentences.zh: 召駐藏大臣孟保來京，以海朴代之。

translations.literal: Tibet resident minister Meng Bao was summoned to the capital and Haipu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Bao was called to Beijing and Haipu replaced him in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 以潘錫恩為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Pan Xi'en was made Jiangnan river conservancy governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Xi'en became Jiangnan river conservancy governor-general.

sentences.zh: 授慧成河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Huicheng was appointed Hedong river conservancy governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Huicheng became Hedong river conservancy governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，允周天爵回籍守制，以廖鴻荃署漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zhou Tianjue was allowed to return home for mourning; Liao Hongquan acted as grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Zhou Tianjue went home to mourn and Liao Hongquan acted as grain transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命怡良查辦達洪阿等妄殺被難洋人。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Yiliang was ordered to investigate Da Hong'a and others for wantonly killing distressed foreigners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Yiliang was sent to investigate Da Hong'a and others for killing foreigners without cause.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，牛鑒論斬。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Niu Jian was sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Niu Jian was condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，給江蘇濱江被兵等丹徒六縣貧民口糧屋費，並免通州等十三州縣廳額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, ration grain and house-repair funds were given to the poor in six Jiangsu counties including Dantu in the war-affected river districts, and quota taxes were remitted with differing amounts for thirteen prefectures, counties, and districts including Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, six war-hit Jiangsu counties including Dantu received grain and repair funds, and thirteen districts including Tongzhou had taxes remitted by degree.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇蕭縣、徐州衛水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was given for flood disaster in Xiaoxian and Xuzhou Guard, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiaoxian and Xuzhou Guard received flood ration grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩浙江淳安等三縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred for three Zhejiang counties including Chun'an.
translations.idiomatic: Chun'an and two other Zhejiang counties had old and new taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，召廖鴻荃來京，以李湘棻署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinsi: Liao Hongquan was summoned to the capital and Li Xiangfen acted as grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, xinsi, Liao Hongquan went to Beijing and Li Xiangfen acted as grain transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己丑，設通永鎮總兵，駐蘆台，以向榮為通永鎮總兵。

translations.literal: On day jichou, a commander was established for Tongyong Garrison at Lutai, with Xiang Rong as Tongyong Garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Tongyong Garrison was set up at Lutai under commander Xiang Rong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，召程矞采來京，以孫善寶為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Cheng Yucai was summoned to the capital and Sun Shanbao was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Cheng Yucai was called to Beijing and Sun Shanbao became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，托渾布病免，以程矞採為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Tuohunbu left for illness and Cheng Yucai was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, ill Tuohunbu left office and Cheng Yucai took Shandong.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，申命大學士、九卿、科道議餘步雲罪，處斬。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Grand Secretaries, Nine Chief Ministers, and censorate officials were again ordered to deliberate Yu Buyun's crime; he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yu Buyun was again tried by the grand secretaries, ministers, and censors and was executed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，調梁寶常為山東巡撫，程矞採為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Liang Baochang was transferred to Shandong governor and Cheng Yucai to Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liang Baochang took Shandong and Cheng Yucai Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 是月，給福建峰市等三縣廳水災口糧屋費。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain and house-repair funds were given for flood disaster in three Fujian counties and districts including Fengshi.
translations.idiomatic: That month three Fujian districts including Fengshi received flood grain and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 是歲，廓爾喀、朝鮮、琉球來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Gurkha, Korea, and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gurkha, Korea, and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月辛亥，命李僡、成剛赴南河，會同潘錫恩督工。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, day xinhai, Li Kan and Cheng Gang were ordered to the Southern River to supervise works jointly with Pan Xi'en.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23, month 1, xinhai, Li Kan and Cheng Gang joined Pan Xi'en supervising Southern River works.

sentences.zh: 壬子，英兵官朴鼎查回香港，留馬禮遜等候議約。

translations.literal: On day renzi, British military officer Pottinger returned to Hong Kong, leaving Morrison behind to await treaty negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Pottinger returned to Hong Kong and Morrison stayed to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 命伊里布等籌辦通商事宜。

translations.literal: Yilibu and others were ordered to arrange commercial-treaty affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibu and others were ordered to handle treaty commerce.

sentences.zh: 命李湘棻會同耆英籌辦江北善後事宜。

translations.literal: Li Xiangfen was ordered with Qiying to arrange postwar affairs north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiangfen and Qiying were ordered to handle north-of-the-river recovery.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇蕭縣、桃源縣災，並給沭陽等六縣衛口糧。

translations.literal: That month, disaster in Xiaoxian and Taoyuan, Jiangsu, was relieved, and ration grain was given to six counties and guards including Shuyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiaoxian and Taoyuan were relieved and six districts including Shuyang received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸湖北江陵等三縣衛，湖南澧州、洞庭二營水災籽種口糧。

translations.literal: Seed grain and ration grain were lent for flood disaster to three Hubei counties and guards including Jiangling and to Lizhou and Dongting camps in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangling and two other Hubei districts and Lizhou and Dongting camps received flood seed and ration loans.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，欽差大臣、廣州將軍伊里布卒，命祁接辦通商稅則。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: Imperial Commissioner and Canton military governor Yilibu died; Qi was ordered to take over commercial-tax regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, yiwei, Yilibu died; Qi took over treaty tax rules.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，烏里雅蘇台將軍奕湘改廣州將軍，以祿普代之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Urga general Yixiang was changed to Canton military governor and Lupu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Yixiang became Canton governor and Lupu replaced him at Urga.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，調奕興為烏里雅蘇台將軍，祿普為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Yixing was transferred to Urga general and Lupu to Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Yixing took Urga and Lupu Suiyuan City.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖北荊州被水駐防倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was lent to flood-stricken Jiangzhou garrison troops in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month flooded Jiangzhou garrison troops in Hubei received lent granary grain.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，命耆英為欽差大臣，辦理江浙通商事宜。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu: Qiying was made Imperial Commissioner to handle Jiangsu-Zhejiang commercial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, gengxu, Qiying became Imperial Commissioner for Jiangsu-Zhejiang commerce.

sentences.zh: 壁昌署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Bi Chang acted as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Chang acted as Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，御試翰林、詹事等官，擢萬青藜五員為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor examined Hanlin and Household officials; Wan Qingli and four others were ranked first class and the rest promoted or demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Emperor tested Hanlin and Household officials; Wan Qingli and four others ranked first and the rest were graded.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，祿普遷鑲紅旗蒙古都統，調奕興為綏遠城將軍，以桂輪為烏里雅蘇台將軍，起琦善為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Lupu was transferred to commander of the Mongol Plain Red Banner; Yixing was transferred to Suiyuan City general; Gui Lun was made Urga general; and Qishan was reinstated as Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Lupu took the Plain Red Mongol command, Yixing Suiyuan City, Gui Lun Urga, and Qishan returned as Rehe commandant.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，起文蔚為古城領隊大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Wenwei was reinstated as Gucheng detachment commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wenwei returned as Gucheng detachment commander.

sentences.zh: 起奕經為葉爾羌幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: Yijing was reinstated as Yarkand assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing returned as Yarkand assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，怡良奏達洪阿、姚瑩並無戰功，命褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Yiliang memorialized that Da Hong'a and Yao Ying had no battle merit and were ordered stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Yiliang said Da Hong'a and Yao Ying had no merit; both were stripped and arrested.

sentences.zh: 尋免達洪阿、姚瑩治罪。

translations.literal: Soon Da Hong'a and Yao Ying were exempted from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Da Hong'a and Yao Ying were spared punishment.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西絳州等六州縣、湖北荊州駐防被災倉穀，江寧駐防暨督協各營災歉兵丁銀，湖南鳳凰等五廳縣苗佃屯丁籽種口糧。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was lent for disaster to six Shanxi prefectures and counties including Jiangzhou and to flood-stricken Jiangzhou garrison stores in Hubei; silver was lent to disaster-afflicted garrison troops at Jiangning and all provincial and assistant camps; and seed grain and ration grain were lent to Miao tenant colonists in five Hunan districts including Fenghuang.
translations.idiomatic: That month six Shanxi districts including Jiangzhou, flooded Jiangzhou stores, Jiangning and camp troops, and five Fenghuang-area Hunan districts received disaster loans.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌朔，以惟勤為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day on day jiaxu: Wei Qin was made Urumchi commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, jiaxu new moon, Wei Qin became Urumchi commandant.

sentences.zh: 丙子，授麟魁禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Lin Kui was appointed Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Lin Kui became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以御史陳慶鏞劾，仍奪琦善、文蔚、奕經職。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, on impeachment by censor Chen Qingyong, Qishan, Wenwei, and Yijing were again stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Chen Qingyong's impeachment again cost Qishan, Wenwei, and Yijing their posts.

sentences.zh: 奎照病免，以特登額為左都御史，薩迎阿為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Kui Zhao left for illness; Tedeng'e was made left censor-in-chief and Saying'a Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Ill Kui Zhao left; Tedeng'e took the left censorate and Saying'a became Rehe commandant.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命耆英與英人會議通商。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Qiying was ordered to confer with the English on commerce.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Qiying was ordered to negotiate trade with Britain.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，怡良病免，以劉韻珂為閩浙總督，調吳其濬為浙江巡撫，以陸費瑔為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Yiliang left for illness; Liu Yunke was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Wu Qijun was transferred to Zhejiang governor; and Lu Fei'en was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, ill Yiliang left; Liu Yunke took Fujian-Zhejiang, Wu Qijun Zhejiang, and Lu Fei'en Hunan.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，湖南武岡州賊匪曾如炷作亂，戕知州徐光弼，命吳其濬討捕之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: the bandit Zeng Ruzhu rebelled at Wugang in Hunan and killed prefect Xu Guangbi; Wu Qijun was ordered to pursue and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, yihai, Zeng Ruzhu rebelled at Wugang, killed Xu Guangbi, and Wu Qijun was sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 甲午，曾如炷伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Zeng Ruzhu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zeng Ruzhu was executed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，河決東河中牟九堡，慧成下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yisi: the Yellow River burst at Jiubao in Zhongmou on the Eastern River; Huicheng was referred to the ministry for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, yisi, the Yellow River broke at Zhongmou Jiubao and Huicheng faced severe review.

sentences.zh: 允耆英奏，定通商稅則，先在廣州市易。

translations.literal: Qiying's memorial was approved fixing commercial-tax regulations, first to be implemented in Guangzhou trade.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying's trade-tax plan was approved, to start in Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 改命敬徵、何汝霖赴東河查勘。

translations.literal: Jingzheng and He Rulin were instead ordered to the Eastern River to survey.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzheng and He Rulin were sent to survey the Eastern River instead.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命鄂順安賑沿河被水災民。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, E Shun'an was ordered to relieve flood victims along the river.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, E Shun'an was ordered to relieve flooded river districts.

sentences.zh: 閏七月戊寅，直隸永定河決。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day wuyin: the Yongding River in Zhili burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 7, wuyin, the Yongding River in Zhili broke.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，中牟決口未塞，命枷慧成河干。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Zhongmou breach was still unclosed; Huicheng was ordered placed in the cangue at the river works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Zhongmou gap was still open and Huicheng was cangued at the works.

sentences.zh: 以鍾祥為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Zhong Xiang was made Hedong river conservancy governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Xiang became Hedong river conservancy governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，召法豐阿來京，以德興為西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Fafeng'a was summoned to the capital and Dexing was made Xining commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Fafeng'a was called to Beijing and Dexing became Xining commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命廖鴻荃往河南，會同督辦河工。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Liao Hongquan was ordered to Henan to supervise river works jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Liao Hongquan went to Henan to co-supervise river works.

sentences.zh: 己丑，起麟慶赴東河督辦河工。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Lin Qing was reinstated and sent to the Eastern River to supervise river works.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Lin Qing returned to supervise Eastern River works.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命敬徵等議製紙鈔。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Jingzheng and others were ordered to deliberate on issuing paper notes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Jingzheng and others were told to plan paper currency.

sentences.zh: 甲午，調吳其濬為雲南巡撫，以管矞群為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Wu Qijun was transferred to Yunnan governor and Guan Yuqun was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wu Qijun took Yunnan and Guan Yuqun Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，申諭程懋采撫恤安徽被水各州縣災民。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: Cheng Maocai was again instructed to comfort and relieve flood victims in flooded Anhui prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, yisi, Cheng Maocai was again told to relieve flooded Anhui districts.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑陝西沔縣等三縣水災雹災。

translations.literal: That month, flood and hail disaster in three Shaanxi counties including Mian was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month three Shaanxi counties including Mian received flood and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，命李湘棻以三品頂戴署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: Li Xiangfen was ordered to act as grain transport governor-general with third-rank top.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, jiawu, Li Xiangfen acted as grain transport governor-general with third-rank top.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山東福山縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in Fushan county, Shandong, was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fushan in Shandong received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸景州等二十七州縣、山東福山縣水災雹災正雜額賦。

translations.literal: Principal and miscellaneous quota taxes were remitted or deferred for flood and hail disaster at twenty-seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Jingzhou and Fushan in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven Zhili districts including Jingzhou and Fushan in Shandong had principal and miscellaneous taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，耆英奏通商事竣，命回兩江總督任，辦善後及上海通商事宜，祁等辦粵省未盡事宜。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiyou: Qiying memorialized that commercial affairs were complete and was ordered back to his Liangjiang governor-general post to handle postwar affairs and Shanghai commerce; Qi and others handled remaining Guangdong affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, jiyou, Qiying finished trade talks and returned to Liangjiang for recovery and Shanghai commerce while Qi handled Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，起琦善為駐藏辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Qishan was reinstated as Tibet commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Qishan returned as Tibet commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲子，起達洪阿為哈密辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Da Hong'a was reinstated as Hami commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Da Hong'a returned as Hami commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽太和等三縣、山西岢嵐州水災雹災。

translations.literal: That month, flood and hail disaster in three Anhui counties including Taihe and Ke'lan in Shanxi was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month Taihe and two other Anhui counties and Ke'lan in Shanxi received flood and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 貸安徽太和等四縣、齊齊哈爾等四處歉收口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was lent for crop failure to four Anhui counties including Taihe and four places including Qiqihar.
translations.idiomatic: Taihe and three other Anhui counties and four places including Qiqihar received failure ration loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩奉天遼陽等六州廳縣、瀋陽等三處，齊齊哈爾等四處，山東臨清等二十七州縣衛，安徽泗州等三十七州縣衛，山西岢嵐等七州縣，湖南澧州等六州縣衛被災新舊正雜額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new principal and miscellaneous quota taxes were remitted or deferred for disaster at six Fengtian prefectures and counties including Liaoyang, three places including Shenyang, four places including Qiqihar, twenty-seven Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Linqing, thirty-seven Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Sizhou, seven Shanxi prefectures and counties including Ke'lan, and six Hunan prefectures, counties, and guards including Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster taxes were remitted or deferred across Liaoyang and five other Fengtian districts, Shenyang and two other places, four Qiqihar-area posts, twenty-seven Linqing-area Shandong districts, thirty-seven Sizhou-area Anhui districts, seven Ke'lan-area Shanxi districts, and six Lizhou-area Hunan districts.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳朔，日食。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day on day jisi: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jisi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以王植為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Wang Zhi was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Wang Zhi became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，調程懋採為浙江巡撫，以王植為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Cheng Maocai was transferred to Zhejiang governor and Wang Zhi to Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Cheng Maocai took Zhejiang and Wang Zhi Anhui.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor went to the Dagao Hall to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇沭陽縣、大河衛災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in Shuyang and Dahe Guard, Jiangsu, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shuyang and Dahe Guard received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 貸江西南昌等十五縣、陝西綏德等九州縣籽種口糧倉穀。

translations.literal: Seed grain, ration grain, and granary grain were lent to fifteen Jiangxi counties including Nanchang and nine Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Suide.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen Jiangxi counties including Nanchang and nine Suide-area Shaanxi districts received seed, ration, and granary loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸新河等四縣、江蘇高郵等六十八州廳縣衛水旱災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred for flood and drought disaster at four Zhili counties including Xinhe and sixty-eight Jiangsu prefectures, districts, counties, and guards including Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhe and three other Zhili counties and sixty-eight Gaoyou-area Jiangsu districts had flood and drought taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，議定意大利亞國通商章程。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou: commercial regulations with Italy were settled.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, xinchou, Italy trade rules were settled.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，調梁寶常為浙江巡撫，以崇恩為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Liang Baochang was transferred to Zhejiang governor and Chong'en was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Liang Baochang took Zhejiang and Chong'en Shandong.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雪。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, it snowed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu it snowed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命劉韻珂辦寧波通商事宜。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Liu Yunke was ordered to handle Ningbo commercial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Liu Yunke was ordered to handle Ningbo trade.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書龔守正病免，以陳官俊代之。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Gong Shouzheng left for illness and Chen Guanjun replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Ill Gong Shouzheng left the Ministry of Rites and Chen Guanjun replaced him.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲緩河南睢州等十六州縣被水新舊正雜額賦。

translations.literal: That month, old and new principal and miscellaneous quota taxes were remitted or deferred for flood disaster at sixteen Henan prefectures and counties including Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month sixteen Suizhou-area Henan districts had flood taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、緬甸、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Burma, and Siam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea, Burma, and Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月辛卯，貸陝西葭州等四州縣、山西大同等三縣水災雹災籽種。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, day xinmao, seed grain was lent for flood and hail disaster in four Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou and three Shanxi counties including Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24, month 1, xinmao, Jiazhou and three other Shaanxi districts and three Datong-area Shanxi counties received hail-flood seed loans.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌朔，祁病免，調耆英為兩廣總督，以壁昌署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Second month, first day on day wuxu: Qi left for illness; Qiying was transferred to Liangguang governor-general and Bi Chang acted as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, wuxu new moon, ill Qi left; Qiying took Liangguang and Bi Chang acted at Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以謁東陵命肅親王敬敏等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, because of visiting the Eastern Tombs, Prince Su Jingmin and others were ordered to remain in Beijing to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, for the Eastern Tombs visit, Prince Su Jingmin and others stayed in Beijing to govern.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以中牟壩工復蟄，褫麟魁、廖鴻荃職，給七品頂戴，仍留河工，鍾祥褫職，留東河總督任，鄂順安降三品頂戴。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, because the Zhongmou dam works relapsed, Lin Kui and Liao Hongquan were stripped of office and given seventh-rank tops but retained at river works; Zhong Xiang was stripped of office but retained as Eastern River governor-general; and E Shun'an was reduced to third-rank top.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, after the Zhongmou dam failed again, Lin Kui and Liao Hongquan were demoted to seventh rank but kept at the works, Zhong Xiang was demoted but kept as Eastern River governor-general, and E Shun'an lost rank to third.

sentences.zh: 以特登額為禮部尚書，文慶為左都御史，調陳官俊為工部尚書，以李宗昉為禮部尚書，杜受田為左都御史。

translations.literal: Tedeng'e was made Minister of Rites, Wen Qing left censor-in-chief, Chen Guanjun was transferred to Minister of Works, Li Zongfang was made Minister of Rites, and Du Shoutian was made left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Tedeng'e took Rites, Wen Qing the left censorate, Chen Guanjun Works, Li Zongfang Rites, and Du Shoutian the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命穆彰阿留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Muzhang'a was ordered to remain in Beijing to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Muzhang'a stayed in Beijing to govern.

sentences.zh: 以程矞采奏米利堅使欲來天津朝覲，並議通商章程，命耆英赴廣東，會同程矞采妥辦米利堅等國通商事宜。

translations.literal: On Cheng Yucai's memorial that the American envoy wished to come to Tianjin for audience and to discuss commercial regulations, Qiying was ordered to Guangdong to settle American and other countries' commerce jointly with Cheng Yucai.
translations.idiomatic: After Cheng Yucai reported an American envoy wanted Tianjin audience and trade rules, Qiying went to Guangdong with him to settle U.S. and other trade.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，免經過地方田賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, land tax along the route was remitted by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, transit land tax was cut by thirty percent.
