sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇海州等三州縣衛民屯口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was given to civilian colonists in three Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month three Haizhou-area Jiangsu districts gave colonist ration grain.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，命耆英為欽差大臣，辦理通商善後事宜，仍令程矞采諭止米里堅使來京。

translations.literal: Third month, day renshen: Qiying was made Imperial Commissioner to handle commercial postwar affairs, and Cheng Yucai was still ordered to instruct the American envoy not to come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, renshen, Qiying became Imperial Commissioner for trade recovery and Cheng Yucai was told to stop the American envoy coming to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，鍾祥等奏河工善後事宜，諭：「一夫失所，罪在朕躬。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zhong Xiang and others reported on river-works follow-up; the Emperor instructed: "When one man loses his livelihood, the fault lies with me personally."
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhong Xiang reported river follow-up and the Emperor said losing one man was his own fault.

sentences.zh: 卿等善為之。

translations.literal: "You ministers manage it well."
translations.idiomatic: "See to it well."

sentences.zh: 」是月，貸山西平定等十一州廳縣歉收倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for poor harvest in eleven Shanxi prefectures and counties including Pingding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Pingding and ten other Shanxi districts received poor-harvest granary loans.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，修廣東虎門各內洋砲台。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiyou: the inner-sea batteries at Guangdong's Humen were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, jiyou, Humen's inner-sea batteries were repaired.

sentences.zh: 壬子，台灣匪平。

translations.literal: On day renzi, bandits in Taiwan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Taiwan bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜孫毓溎等二百有九人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Sun Yuqin and 209 others were granted jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Sun Yuqin and 209 others received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 是月，加給河南睢州等十五州縣水災三月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, three months' flood ration grain was added for fifteen Henan prefectures and counties including Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Suizhou and fourteen other Henan districts received three months' flood rations.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，直隸永定河決。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingyou: the Yongding River in Zhili burst.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, dingyou, Zhili's Yongding River burst.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，湖南耒陽縣匪楊大鵬等作亂，命陸費瑔等討捕之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, bandits led by Yang Dapeng rose in Leiyang County, Hunan; Lu Fei'en and others were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Yang Dapeng's Leiyang bandits rose; Lu Fei'en was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 己酉，定米利堅通商條約。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the American commercial treaty was settled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the American trade treaty was settled.

sentences.zh: 是月，緩徵山東臨清等二十二州縣並德州東昌二衛被災新舊額賦有差。

translations.literal: That month, new and old quota levies were deferred by degree for twenty-two Shandong prefectures and counties including Linqing and the Dezhou and Dongchang guards.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Linqing and twenty-one other Shandong districts plus Dezhou and Dongchang guards had taxes deferred.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，富呢揚阿及提督周悅勝下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinsi: Funiyang'a and Regional Commander Zhou Yuesheng were referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, xinsi, Funiyang'a and Zhou Yuesheng faced severe ministry review.

sentences.zh: 甲申，湖南耒陽縣匪平，匪首楊大鵬伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, bandits in Leiyang County, Hunan, were pacified; ringleader Yang Dapeng was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Leiyang bandits were pacified and Yang Dapeng was executed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，湖北荊州萬成堤決。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Wancheng dike at Jingzhou, Hubei, burst.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Jingzhou's Wancheng dike burst.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，召奕興來京，以鐵麟署綏遠城將軍，阿彥泰署察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Yixing was summoned to the capital; Tielin acted as Suiyuan garrison general and Ayantai acted as Chahar governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Yixing was called to Beijing; Tielin acted at Suiyuan and Ayantai at Chahar.

sentences.zh: 是月，加給河南中牟等九縣水災三月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, three months' flood ration grain was added for nine Henan counties including Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhongmou and eight other Henan counties received three months' flood rations.

sentences.zh: 貸陝西葭州雹災籽種。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned for hail disaster at Shaanxi's Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Prefecture in Shaanxi received hail seed loans.

sentences.zh: 八月，賑山西汾陽縣水災雹災，並蠲緩汾陽等三縣額賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month: flood and hail victims in Fenyang, Shanxi, were relieved, and quota levies were remitted or deferred for Fenyang and two other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, Fenyang and two other Shanxi counties were relieved and taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 九月，給河南淮寧等三縣三月水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ninth month: three months' flood ration grain was given to three Henan counties including Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, Huaining and two other Henan counties received three months' flood rations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午朔，准布魯特阿希木襲四品翎頂。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day jiawu: Ashimu of the Buruts was allowed to inherit a fourth-rank plumed-cap insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon in month 10, Burut Ashimu inherited a fourth-rank plume.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葉爾羌參贊大臣奕經改伊犁領隊大臣，以麟魁代之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Yarkand consultant minister Yijing was transferred to Ili commandant and Lin Kui replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Yijing left Yarkand for Ili and Lin Kui replaced him.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，伊犁參贊大臣達洪阿病免。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Ili consultant minister Dahong'a was dismissed for illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, ill Dahong'a left the Ili post.

sentences.zh: 命林則徐赴阿克蘇、烏什、庫車、和闐等處勘議開墾事宜。

translations.literal: Lin Zexu was ordered to proceed to Aksu, Ush, Kuqa, Khotan, and other places to survey and deliberate opening land for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Zexu was sent to Aksu, Ush, Kuqa, Khotan, and elsewhere to plan reclamation.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以舒興阿為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Shuxing'a was made Ili consultant minister.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Shuxing'a became Ili consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸霸州、永清二州縣旗民。

translations.literal: That month, banner civilians in Bazhou and Yongqing, Zhili, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Bazhou and Yongqing banner civilians were relieved.

sentences.zh: 給奉天錦州等八州廳縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: Flood ration grain was given in eight Fengtian prefectures and counties including Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhou and seven other Fengtian districts received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸霸州等三十七州縣、奉天金州等八州縣廳、湖北沔陽等二十九州縣衛水旱災雹災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for water, drought, and hail disasters in thirty-seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou, eight Fengtian counties including Jinzhou, and twenty-nine Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Mianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Bazhou-area Zhili, Jinzhou-area Fengtian, and Mianyang-area Hubei had disaster taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，允桂良來覲，以吳其濬兼署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: Gui Liang was permitted to come to audience; Wu Qijun concurrently acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, yichou, Gui Liang came to audience and Wu Qijun acted Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 前刑部侍郎黃爵滋以員外郎等官用。

translations.literal: Former Vice Minister of Punishments Huang Juezi was employed as an outside-department official.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Juezi, former Punishments vice minister, was used as an outside-department officer.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor went to the Hall of Great Height to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Height.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸盛京金州水師營歉收口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was loaned for poor harvest to the maritime-camp troops at Shengjing's Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jinzhou maritime-camp troops received poor-harvest ration loans.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳朔，上再詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day guisi: the Emperor again went to the Hall of Great Height to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon in month 12, the Emperor again prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Height.

sentences.zh: 庚子，申命林則徐赴喀什噶爾查勘開荒。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Lin Zexu was again ordered to proceed to Kashgar to survey opening wasteland.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Lin Zexu was again sent to Kashgar to survey reclamation.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor again went to the Hall of Great Height to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Emperor again prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Height.

sentences.zh: 命卓秉恬為大學士，以陳官俊為禮部尚書、協辦大學士，杜受田為工部尚書，祝慶蕃為左都御史。

translations.literal: Zhuo Bingdi was made Grand Secretary; Chen Guanjun Minister of Rites and associate Grand Secretary; Du Shoutian Minister of Works; Zhu Qingfan Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo Bingdi became grand secretary; Chen Guanjun took Rites and became associate secretary; Du Shoutian Works; Zhu Qingfan the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 是月，加給河南睢州等十五州縣被災口糧，並貸籽種倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, additional disaster ration grain was given to fifteen Henan prefectures and counties including Suizhou, and seed and granary grain were loaned.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Suizhou and fourteen other Henan districts received extra rations plus seed and granary loans.

sentences.zh: 貸江寧駐防兵丁、江蘇各營兵匠銀米。

translations.literal: Silver and grain were loaned to garrison troops at Nanjing and artisan soldiers in Jiangsu camps.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing garrison troops and Jiangsu camp artisans received silver and grain loans.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月乙丑，河南中牟河工合龍。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, day yichou: the Zhongmou river works in Henan joined.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25, month 1, yichou, Henan's Zhongmou river works closed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，調李星沅為江蘇巡撫，惠吉為陝西巡撫，以程矞採為漕運總督，黃恩彤為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Li Xingyuan was transferred to Jiangsu provincial governor, Huiji to Shaanxi provincial governor, Cheng Yucai made Grain Transport governor-general, and Huang Entong Guangdong provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Li Xingyuan took Jiangsu, Huiji Shaanxi, Cheng Yucai Grain Transport, and Huang Entong Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 戊子，召容照來京，以麟慶為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Rongzhao was summoned to the capital; Lin Qing was made Urga commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Rongzhao was called to Beijing and Lin Qing took Urga.

sentences.zh: 是月，給直隸霸州、永清二州縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was given to disaster victims in Bazhou and Yongqing, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Bazhou and Yongqing disaster victims received rations.

sentences.zh: 貸江西德化等五縣，湖北江陵等六縣衛，湖南沅江、安鄉二縣軍民籽種。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned to five Jiangxi counties including Dehua, six Hubei counties and guards including Jiangling, and two Hunan counties including Yuanjiang and Anxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Dehua and four other Jiangxi counties, Jiangling and five other Hubei districts, and Yuanjiang and Anxiang received seed loans.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以福濟為總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Fujie was made chief steward of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Fujie became Imperial Household chief steward.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，睿親王仁壽坐濫保海朴，褫宗人府左宗正、領侍衛內大臣、內廷行走。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Prince Rui of the First Rank Ren Shou, for indiscriminately recommending Haipu, was stripped of left director of the Imperial Clan Court, commanding imperial bodyguard, and inner-palace attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Prince Rui Ren Shou lost clan-court, bodyguard, and inner-palace posts for recommending Haipu.

sentences.zh: 敬徵坐濫保孟保，褫協辦大學士、戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Jingzheng, for indiscriminately recommending Mengbao, was stripped of associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzheng lost associate secretary and Revenue for recommending Mengbao.

sentences.zh: 命兩廣總督耆英協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Liang-Guang Governor-General Qiying was ordered to be associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying became associate grand secretary while at Liang-Guang.

sentences.zh: 調賽尚阿為戶部尚書，裕誠為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Saishang'a was transferred to Minister of Revenue and Yucheng to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a took Revenue and Yucheng Works.

sentences.zh: 以文慶為兵部尚書，成剛為左都御史。

translations.literal: Wenqing was made Minister of War and Chenggang Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqing became War minister and Chenggang left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 調僧格林沁為鑲黃旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Senggelinqin was transferred to commanding imperial bodyguard of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Senggelinqin took the Bordered Yellow Banner bodyguard command.

sentences.zh: 以車登巴咱爾為正黃旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Chedengbazha'er was made commanding imperial bodyguard of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chedengbazha'er took the Plain Yellow Banner bodyguard command.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，調惠吉為福建巡撫，以鄧廷楨為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Huiji was transferred to Fujian provincial governor and Deng Tingzhen made Shaanxi provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Huiji took Fujian and Deng Tingzhen Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，頒發五口通商章程。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the five-port commercial regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the five-port trade regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上閱圓明園八旗槍兵。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor reviewed firearms troops of the Eight Banners at the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Emperor reviewed Eight Banner musketry at Yuanmingyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，麟慶病免，以成凱為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day weiwei, Lin Qing was dismissed for illness and Chengkai made Urga commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On weiwei, ill Lin Qing left Urga and Chengkai replaced him.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西忻州等十七州縣廳歉收倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for poor harvest in seventeen Shanxi prefectures and counties including Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xinzhou and sixteen other Shanxi districts received poor-harvest granary loans.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，桂良留京，以賀長齡為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao: Gui Liang remained in the capital and He Changling was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, guimao, Gui Liang stayed in Beijing and He Changling took Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，調吳其濬為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Wu Qijun was transferred to Fujian provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wu Qijun became Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 惠吉為雲南巡撫，以喬用遷為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Huiji was made Yunnan provincial governor and Qiao Yongqian Guizhou provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: Huiji took Yunnan and Qiao Yongqian Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor went to the Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 壬子，富呢揚阿卒，以惠吉為陝西巡撫，鄧廷楨署之，以鄭祖琛為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Funiyang'a died; Huiji was made Shaanxi provincial governor with Deng Tingzhen acting, and Zheng Zuchen Yunnan provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Funiyang'a died; Huiji took Shaanxi with Deng Tingzhen acting and Zheng Zuchen Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜蕭錦忠等二百十七人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Xiao Jingzhong and 217 others were granted jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Xiao Jingzhong and 217 others received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，裕誠、許乃普降調，以敬徵為工部尚書，何汝霖為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Yucheng and Xu Naipu were demoted and transferred; Jingzheng was made Minister of Works and He Rulin Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Yucheng and Xu Naipu were demoted; Jingzheng took Works and He Rulin War.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingxu: rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingxu, it rained.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上再詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor again went to the Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Emperor again prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 是月，給山東樂安等六縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, flood ration grain was given to six Shandong counties including Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Le'an and five other Shandong counties received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，允比利時國通商。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu: commerce with Belgium was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jiawu, Belgian trade was permitted.

sentences.zh: 詔停本年秋決。

translations.literal: An edict halted autumn executions for that year.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn executions were halted that year.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命崇恩剿捕濮州、鄆城等處捻匪。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Chong'en was ordered to suppress Nian bandits at Puzhou, Yancheng, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Chong'en was sent against Nian bandits in Puzhou, Yancheng, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑台灣彰化縣地震災民。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, earthquake victims in Taiwan's Changhua County were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Changhua earthquake victims in Taiwan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，阿克蘇辦事大臣輯瑞以墾荒未奏率即興工，褫職。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Aksu commissioner Jirui, for opening wasteland and starting work before reporting to the throne, was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Jirui lost office for starting reclamation before memorializing the throne.

sentences.zh: 己未，江蘇中河廳桃源汛河決。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Taoyuan flood in Jiangsu's Central River Office burst.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Jiangsu Central River Office's Taoyuan flood burst.

sentences.zh: 甘肅西寧鎮總兵慶和遇番賊於金羊嶺，死之。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Qinghe of Gansu's Xining Garrison met barbarian bandits at Jinyang Ridge and died.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghe, Xining regional commander, died fighting bandits at Jinyang Ridge.

sentences.zh: 命惠吉剿捕番賊。

translations.literal: Huiji was ordered to suppress the barbarian bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Huiji was sent to suppress the barbarian bandits.

sentences.zh: 是月，緩徵山東濱州等四十二州縣衛被災逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue levies from disaster were deferred for forty-two Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Binzhou and forty-one other Shandong districts had overdue disaster levies deferred.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，允丹麻爾國通商。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinwei: commerce with Denmark was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, xinwei, Danish trade was permitted.

sentences.zh: 命大學士卓秉恬管兵部。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Zhuo Bingdi was ordered to supervise the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo Bingdi was ordered to oversee War.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命達洪阿赴甘肅查辦番賊。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Dahong'a was ordered to proceed to Gansu to investigate and handle the barbarian bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Dahong'a was sent to Gansu to handle the barbarian bandits.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，詔皇太后七旬萬壽，免道光二十年以前實欠正雜田賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renchen: for the Empress Dowager's seventieth birthday, land tax actually owed before Daoguang 20 was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, renchen, for the empress dowager's seventieth birthday, land tax owed before Daoguang 20 was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，調鄭祖琛為福建巡撫，梁萼涵為雲南巡撫，吳其濬為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Zheng Zuchen was transferred to Fujian provincial governor, Liang Yuhan to Yunnan, and Wu Qijun to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zheng Zuchen took Fujian, Liang Yuhan Yunnan, and Wu Qijun Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 敬徵病免，調特登額為工部尚書，以保昌為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Jingzheng was dismissed for illness; Tedeng'e was transferred to Minister of Works and Baochang Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Ill Jingzheng left office; Tedeng'e took Works and Baochang Rites.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，召林則徐回京，以四五品京堂候補。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Lin Zexu was summoned to the capital to await assignment as fourth- or fifth-rank capital official.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Lin Zexu was called to Beijing for fourth- or fifth-rank capital appointment.

sentences.zh: 禧恩病免，調奕湘為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Xi'en was dismissed for illness and Yixiang transferred to Shengjing general.
translations.idiomatic: Ill Xi'en left office and Yixiang became Shengjing general.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，加上皇太后徽號曰恭慈康裕安成庄惠壽禧崇祺皇太后。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu: the Empress Dowager was given the honorific title "Reverent, Kind, Tranquil, Prosperous, Accomplished, Solemn, Bountiful, Long-lived, Auspicious, Esteemed, Blessed Empress Dowager."
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, jiawu, the empress dowager received a new twelve-character honorific title.

sentences.zh: 上進冊寶，率皇子及王、公、大臣等行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: The Emperor presented the registers and seals; the princes, dukes, and grand ministers performed congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor presented registers and seals and princes, dukes, and ministers congratulated.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，皇太后七旬聖壽，上率皇子、王、公、大臣行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, on the Empress Dowager's seventieth birthday, the Emperor led princes, dukes, and grand ministers in congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the empress dowager's seventieth birthday, the Emperor led congratulations.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李宗昉病免，以祝慶蕃為禮部尚書，魏元烺為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Li Zongfang was dismissed for illness; Zhu Qingfan Minister of Rites and Wei Yuanhuang Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, ill Li Zongfang left office; Zhu Qingfan took Rites and Wei Yuanhuang the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以上皇太后徽號禮成，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day guimao, because the empress dowager honorific ceremony was complete, an edict granted differentiated general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, after the honorific rites, differentiated amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，免直隸道光二十年以前民欠各項旗租。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, banner rent owed by civilians in Zhili before Daoguang 20 was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhili civilian banner rent owed before Daoguang 20 was remitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸寶坻等四縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in four Zhili counties including Baodi were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Baodi and three other Zhili counties were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，陝甘總督惠吉卒，以布彥泰為陝甘總督，林則徐署之，薩迎阿為伊犁將軍，桂良為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinyou: Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Huiji died; Buyantai was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general with Lin Zexu acting; Saying'a Ili general and Gui Liang Rehe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, xinyou, Huiji died; Buyantai took Shaanxi-Gansu with Lin Zexu acting, Saying'a Ili, and Gui Liang Rehe.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，御史陳慶鏞降調。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Censor Chen Qingyong was demoted and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Chen Qingyong was demoted and transferred.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸熱河圍場歉收兵丁銀。

translations.literal: That month, silver was loaned to soldiers in straitened Rehe hunting grounds.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Rehe hunting-ground soldiers received silver loans.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinmao: the Emperor went to the Hall of Great Height to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, xinmao, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Height.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，免台灣道光二十年以前民欠租穀糧米。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, rent grain and rice owed by civilians in Taiwan before Daoguang 20 was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Taiwan civilian rent grain and rice owed before Daoguang 20 was remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上再詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor again went to the Hall of Great Height to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Emperor again prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Height.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上復詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor again went to the Hall of Great Height to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Emperor again prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Height.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、越南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Vietnam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea and Vietnam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月庚辰，命賽尚阿、周祖培查勘江防。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, spring, first month, day gengchen: Saishang'a and Zhou Zupei were ordered to survey the river defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26, month 1, gengchen, Saishang'a and Zhou Zupei were sent to survey river defenses.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，弛天主教禁。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the ban on Catholicism was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Catholic ban was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 以陸建瀛為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Lu Jianying was made Yunnan provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jianying became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，給奉天鳳凰城、岫岩廳旗民，直隸寶坻等四縣口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to banner people at Fengtian's Fengcheng and Xiuyan subprefecture and in four Zhili counties including Baodi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fengcheng and Xiuyan banner people and Baodi and three other Zhili counties received rations.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅靜寧等十三縣災民籽種。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned to disaster victims in thirteen Gansu counties including Jingning.
translations.idiomatic: Jingning and twelve other Gansu counties received seed loans.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，雲南永昌回匪作亂，命提督張必祿剿之。

translations.literal: Second month, day jichou: Hui rebels rose at Yongchang, Yunnan; provincial commander-in-chief Zhang Bilu was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jichou, Yongchang Hui rebels rose; Zhang Bilu was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以謁陵命定郡堊載銓等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day yimao, for the tomb visit Prince Ding, Zaiquan, and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Zaiquan and others stayed in Beijing for the tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，上謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: Third month, day haihai: the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted one-third of quota levies in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, haihai, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted one-third of passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵、至孝穆皇后、孝慎皇后、孝全皇后陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor offered libation at Tailing, Tai East Tombs, Changling, and the tombs of Empress Xiaomu, Empress Xiaoshen, and Empress Xiaoquan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Emperor poured libations at Tai, Tai East, Chang, and the three empresses' tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the battue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上行圍，翌日如之。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor conducted the battue; the next day he did the same.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei and again the next day, the Emperor hunted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 興平倉火。

translations.literal: Fire broke out at the Xingping granary.
translations.idiomatic: The Xingping granary burned.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor went to the Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 以林則徐為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Lin Zexu was made Shaanxi provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Zexu became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西平定等九州縣歉收倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for poor harvests in nine Shanxi prefectures and counties including Pingding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Pingding and eight other Shanxi districts received granary loans for poor harvest.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，以雲南永昌回民藉端尋釁，命賀長齡查辦，丙午，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: because Yongchang Muslims seized pretexts to stir trouble, He Changling was ordered to investigate; on day bingwu the Emperor again went to the Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, xinchou, He Changling investigated Yongchang Muslim unrest; on bingwu the Emperor again prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以瑞元為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Ruiyuan was made Kobdo consultant minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Ruiyuan became Kobdo consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu: the Emperor went to the Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, renxu, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張必祿敗回匪於永昌。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Zhang Bilu defeated the Hui rebels at Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhang Bilu beat the rebels at Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 以上年殺永昌內應回民過多，賀長齡下部議處。

translations.literal: Because too many cooperating Yongchang Muslims were killed last year, He Changling was referred to the ministries for disciplinary action.
translations.idiomatic: He Changling faced ministry discipline for excessive killings of Yongchang Muslim collaborators last year.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上復詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor again went to the Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Emperor again prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 英人退出舟山。

translations.literal: The British withdrew from Zhoushan.
translations.idiomatic: British forces left Zhoushan.

sentences.zh: 閏五月乙酉朔，青海黑錯四溝番作亂，命布彥泰剿之。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, new moon on day yiyou: Tibetans of Hei Cuo Four Gullies in Qinghai rebelled; Buyantai was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon in intercalary month 5, Hei Cuo Four Gullies Tibetans rebelled; Buyantai was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，永昌回匪遁入猛庭，賀長齡督兵剿之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yongchang Hui rebels fled into Mengting; He Changling directed troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Yongchang rebels fled to Mengting; He Changling pursued them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以麟魁為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Lin Kui was made Uliassutai consultant minister.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Lin Kui became Uliassutai consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，命祁俊藻、文慶查辦天津鹽務。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: Qi Junzao and Wenqing were ordered to investigate Tianjin salt administration.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, wuwu, Qi Junzao and Wenqing were assigned to inspect Tianjin salt affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以予告大學士阮元重逢鄉舉，晉太傅，食全俸。

translations.literal: On day renwu, because retiring Grand Secretary Ruan Yuan had again passed the provincial examination, he was promoted to Grand Tutor with full salary.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Ruan Yuan, retired but re-examined, was made Grand Tutor at full pay.

sentences.zh: 癸未，達洪阿剿竄匿果岔番賊，敗之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Dahunga suppressed Guangoufan bandits in hiding and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Dahunga routed hiding Guangoufan bandits.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，禧恩以失察奸民，褫公爵，降鎮國將軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinmao: Xi'en, for failure to detect wicked commoners, was stripped of his dukedom and reduced to Banner General of the State.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, xinmao, Xi'en lost his dukedom and became a banner general for lax oversight.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上閱吉林、黑龍江官兵馬步射。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor reviewed mounted and foot archery of Jilin and Heilongjiang troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Emperor reviewed Jilin and Heilongjiang archery.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以雲南漢、回積嫌未釋，命賀長齡持平辦理，勿分畛域。

translations.literal: On day guimao, because old Han-Muslim grievances in Yunnan were unresolved, He Changling was ordered to handle matters impartially and not draw boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, He Changling was told to settle Yunnan Han-Muslim feuds impartially, without taking sides.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，申嚴門禁。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, gate security was tightened.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, capital gates were strictly guarded.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑三姓及寧古塔等處水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given at Sanshing and Ningguta and other places.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood victims at Sanshing, Ningguta, and elsewhere were relieved.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，命盛京、直隸、江南、浙江、福建、山東、廣東七省將軍、督、撫籌辦練兵儲餉。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen: generals, governors, and governors-general of seven provinces—Shengjing, Zhili, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Fujian, Shandong, and Guangdong—were ordered to plan troop drill and stores of pay and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, renshen, seven provincial commanders were told to ready drill, pay, and grain.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Firearms Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Emperor reviewed the Firearms Camp.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賀長齡以防剿無功，降河南布政使。

translations.literal: On day yihai, He Changling, for failing in defense and suppression, was demoted to Henan provincial administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, He Changling was demoted to Henan administrator after campaign failure.

sentences.zh: 命李星沅為雲貴總督，調陸建瀛為江蘇巡撫，以張日晸為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Xingyuan was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Lu Jianying was transferred to Jiangsu governor; Zhang Rizhen was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xingyuan took Yunnan-Guizhou, Lu Jianying Jiangsu, and Zhang Rizhen Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，布魯特匪入喀什噶爾卡倫，命賽什雅勒泰剿之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Burut bandits entered the Kashgar pass; Saishiyaletai was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Buruts crossed into Kashgar; Saishiyaletai was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，湖南新田縣匪王棕獻等作亂，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jihai: in Xintian county, Hunan, bandits led by Wang Zongxian and others rebelled and were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, jihai, Wang Zongxian's Xintian rebels were seized and killed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以楊殿邦署漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Yang Dianbang was made acting grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yang Dianbang acted as grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，江蘇昭文縣匪金得順等作亂，捕誅之。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, in Zhaowen county, Jiangsu, bandits led by Jin Deshun and others rebelled and were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhaowen's Jin Deshun rebels were captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山東東平、萊蕪二州縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in two Shandong prefectures and counties, Dongping and Laiwu, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dongping and Laiwu flood victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 賑三姓、琿春水災旗民。

translations.literal: Banner people afflicted by floods at Sanshing and Hunchun were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Flood-hit banner people at Sanshing and Hunchun were relieved.

sentences.zh: 給山東汶上等四縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued to disaster victims in four Shandong counties including Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Wen and three other Shandong counties received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩奉天遼陽等十三州廳縣、直隸霸州等三十五州縣、山東東平等四州縣災歉新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for thirteen Fengtian prefectures, departments, and counties including Liaoyang, thirty-five Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou, and four Shandong prefectures and counties including Dongping that had suffered disaster and poor harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster quota taxes were eased for Liaoyang and twelve other Fengtian units, Bazhou and thirty-four other Zhili units, and Dongping and three other Shandong units.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，免黑錯四溝番民額賦。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingsi: quota levies of the Hei Cuo Four Gullies Tibetans were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, dingsi, Hei Cuo Four Gullies Tibetans were exempted from quota levies.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以徐繼畬為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Xu Jisuo was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Xu Jisuo became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，給河南汲縣等八縣，陝西府谷、神木二縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to disaster victims in eight Henan counties including Ji and two Shaanxi counties, Fugu and Shenmu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Ji and seven other Henan counties and Fugu and Shenmu received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩湖南澧州等五州縣暨岳州衛被災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota levies were remitted or deferred for five Hunan prefectures and counties including Lizhou and Yuezhou Guard that had suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhou and four other Hunan units plus Yuezhou Guard received disaster tax relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，桂輪改荊州將軍，以特依順為烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou: Guilun was transferred to Jingzhou general; Te Yishun was made Uliassutai general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, yiyou, Guilun went to Jingzhou and Te Yishun took Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor went to the Dagao Hall to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命壁昌等籌議江蘇漕糧酌分海運。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Bichang and others were ordered to plan division of Jiangsu tribute grain transport by sea.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Bichang and others were told to plan partial sea transport of Jiangsu grain.

sentences.zh: 己酉，黃恩彤以奏請賜應試年老武生職銜，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Huang Entong, for memorializing to grant official titles to elderly military licentiates taking the examination, was referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Huang Entong faced ministry scrutiny for asking titles for old military examinees.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命山東嚴緝虜人勒贖匪。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Shandong was ordered strictly to apprehend kidnappers who extorted ransom.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Shandong was told to crack down on kidnapping for ransom.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山西垣曲縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in Yuanqu county, Shanxi, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yuanqu flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩山西保德等六州縣暨歸化城等三處、浙江餘杭等四十四縣衛、直隸安州等六州縣被災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for six Shanxi prefectures and counties including Baode and three places including Guihuacheng, forty-four Zhejiang counties and guards including Yuhang, and six Zhili prefectures and counties including Anzhou that had suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster taxes were eased for Baode and five other Shanxi units, three Guihua units, Yuhang and forty-three other Zhejiang units, and Anzhou and five other Zhili units.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，黃恩彤褫職，調徐廣縉為廣東巡撫，以程矞採為雲南巡撫，楊殿邦為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: Huang Entong was dismissed from office; Xu Guangjin was transferred to Guangdong governor; Cheng Yusai was made Yunnan governor; Yang Dianbang was made grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, guichou, Huang Entong was dismissed, Xu Guangjin went to Guangdong, Cheng Yusai to Yunnan, and Yang Dianbang took grain transport.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，雲南猛統回匪竄入緬寧，命陸建瀛查辦。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Mengtong Hui rebels from Yunnan slipped into Linning; Lu Jianying was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Mengtong rebels entered Linning; Lu Jianying was assigned the case.

sentences.zh: 甲子，西寧辦事大臣達洪阿病免，以哈勒吉那代之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Xining frontier commissioner Dahunga was dismissed for illness; Halejina replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, ill Dahunga left Xining and Halejina succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以王兆琛為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Wang Zhaochen was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wang Zhaochen became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命清釐刑部及直隸、山東、山西、河南、陝西、甘肅各省庶獄。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, a general review of cases was ordered at the Board of Punishments and in Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the punishment ministry and six provinces were ordered to clear backlog cases.

sentences.zh: 命寶興留京管刑部。

translations.literal: Bao Xing was left in the capital to manage the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Xing stayed in Beijing to run the punishment ministry.

sentences.zh: 賞琦善二品頂戴，為四州總督。

translations.literal: Qishan was granted second-rank insignia and made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan received second rank and the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general post.

sentences.zh: 丙子，調鄭祖琛為廣西巡撫，徐繼畬為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zheng Zuchen was transferred to Guangxi governor and Xu Jisuo to Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Zheng Zuchen took Guangxi and Xu Jisuo Fujian.

sentences.zh: 是月，給浙江縉雲、宣平二縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for flood disasters in two Zhejiang counties, Jinyun and Xuanping.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jinyun and Xuanping received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月癸未，調成凱為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, day guiwei: Cheng Kai was transferred to Tarbagatai consultant minister.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27, spring, month 1, guiwei, Cheng Kai went to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鐵麟遷荊州將軍，以裕誠為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Tielin was transferred to Jingzhou general and Yucheng made Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Tielin took Jingzhou and Yucheng Chahar.

sentences.zh: 是月，給浙江富陽等六縣衛、安徽五河等三縣、江蘇桃源等五縣衛上年災歉口糧，河南河內等十三縣水旱災口糧籽種，並貸輝縣等八縣倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, last year's disaster rations were issued to six Zhejiang counties and guards including Fuyang, three Anhui counties including Wuhe, five Jiangsu counties and guards including Taoyuan, and disaster rations and seed to thirteen Henan counties including Henei, and granary grain was loaned to eight counties including Huixian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fuyang and other disaster districts in Zhejiang, Anhui, and Jiangsu received rations; Henei and twelve other Henan counties received rations and seed; Huixian and seven others received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 貸陝西葭州等三州縣、直隸霸州等三十九州縣災歉籽種口糧倉穀。

translations.literal: Seed grain, ration grain, and granary grain were loaned for disaster and poor harvest to three Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiaz and thirty-nine Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster loans went to Jiaz and two other Shaanxi units and Bazhou and thirty-eight other Zhili units.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，雲南雲州回匪作亂，命李星沅剿之。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiwei: Hui rebels rose at Yunzhou, Yunnan; Li Xingyuan was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiwei, Yunzhou Hui rebels rose; Li Xingyuan was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以謁陵，命載銓等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day haihai, for the tomb visit Zaiquan and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On haihai, Zaiquan and others stayed in Beijing for the tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以福建海盜劫殺洋商，命劉韻珂等搜捕。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, because Fujian pirates had robbed and killed foreign merchants, Liu Yunke and others were ordered to hunt them down.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Liu Yunke was told to hunt Fujian pirates who killed foreign merchants.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上謁東陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and remitted one-third of quota levies in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and remitted one-third of passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 是月，給河南汲縣等五縣被災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to disaster victims in five Henan counties including Ji.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Ji and four other Henan counties received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 乙未，壁昌遷內大臣，調李星沅為兩江總督，以林則徐為雲貴總督，楊以增為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Bichang was transferred to inner court minister; Li Xingyuan was transferred to Liangjiang governor-general; Lin Zexu was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Yang Yizeng was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Bichang entered the inner court, Li Xingyuan took Liangjiang, Lin Zexu Yunnan-Guizhou, and Yang Yizeng Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，英船退出虎門。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, British ships withdrew from Humen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, British ships left Humen.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以魏元烺為禮部尚書，賈楨為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Wei Yuanhuang was made Minister of Rites and Jia Zhen Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Wei Yuanhuang took Rites and Jia Zhen the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，布魯特匪復攻色埒庫勒，伯克巴什等擊走之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuwu: Burut bandits again attacked Serkule; Bekbash and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, wuwu, Buruts attacked Serkule and Bekbash repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 賽什雅勒泰等奏英人據音底、努普爾，各部咸附之。

translations.literal: Saishiyaletai and others memorialized that the British held Indi and Nupur and that all tribes had submitted to them.
translations.idiomatic: Saishiyaletai reported British occupation of Indi and Nupur and widespread tribal submission.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，免熱河豐寧縣逋賦及旗租銀。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, arrears of quota levies and banner rent silver were remitted for Fengning county, Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Fengning's tax and banner-rent arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賜張之萬等二百三十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhang Zhiwan and two hundred thirty-one others were granted jinshi degrees and origin-ranks by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Zhang Zhiwan and 231 others received jinshi ranks by degree.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江西上高、新昌二縣，湖南鳳凰等五廳縣屯丁苗佃籽種口糧。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain and ration grain were loaned to two Jiangxi counties, Shanggao and Xinchang, and to garrison colonists and Miao tenants in five Hunan departments and counties including Fenghuang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shanggao and Xinchang and five Fenghuang-area units received seed and ration loans.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，御試翰林、詹事等官，擢王慶雲四員為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingxu: the Emperor held the palace examination for Hanlin and Academician officials; Wang Qingyun and four others were advanced to first class and the rest promoted or demoted with difference.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingxu, the palace exam ranked Wang Qingyun and four first and adjusted the rest.

sentences.zh: 何汝霖憂免，調魏元烺為兵部尚書，以賈楨為禮部尚書，孫瑞珍為左都御史。

translations.literal: He Rulin left office on mourning; Wei Yuanhuang was transferred to Minister of War; Jia Zhen was made Minister of Rites; Sun Ruizhen was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He Rulin mourned; Wei Yuanhuang took War, Jia Zhen Rites, and Sun Ruizhen the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命文慶、陳孚恩在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Wenqing and Chen Fuen were ordered to walk as supernumeraries above the Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wenqing and Chen Fuen joined the Grand Council as supernumeraries.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以廣東民情與洋人易啟釁端，命擇紳士襄辦交涉事宜。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, because Guangdong popular sentiment easily led to clashes with foreigners, gentry were selected to assist in handling foreign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Guangdong gentry were chosen to help manage foreign contact and avoid clashes.

sentences.zh: 丁未，擢曾國籓為內閣學士。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Zeng Guofan was promoted to Hanlin Academician of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Zeng Guofan became a secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 六月，理籓院奏俄羅斯達喇嘛請在塔爾巴哈台、伊犁、喀什噶爾通商，不許。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the Court of Colonial Affairs memorialized that a Russian lama had requested trade at Tarbagatai, Ili, and Kashgar; permission was denied.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, the Colonial Office refused a Russian lama's request to trade at Tarbagatai, Ili, and Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，命林則徐讞雲南回民控訴香匪殺無辜一萬餘人之獄。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jimao: Lin Zexu was ordered to try the case of Yunnan Muslims charging that Xiang bandits had killed more than ten thousand innocents.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, jimao, Lin Zexu was assigned the Yunnan Muslim case over Xiang-bandit mass killings.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命林則徐讞雲南回民杜文秀控訴被誣從逆之獄。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Lin Zexu was ordered to try the case of Yunnan Muslim Du Wenxiu charging false accusation of rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Lin Zexu took Du Wenxiu's false-rebellion case.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以河南旱災，發庫銀十萬兩，並撥鄰省銀二十萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, because of drought disaster in Henan, one hundred thousand taels from the treasury and two hundred thousand taels transferred from neighboring provinces were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Henan drought relief received 100,000 treasury taels and 200,000 from neighbors.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，安集延匪犯喀什噶爾，吉明等擊走之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: Andijan bandits attacked Kashgar; Jiming and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jiyou, Andijan raiders hit Kashgar and Jiming repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 賽什雅勒泰自殺，調奕山為葉爾羌參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Saishiyaletai committed suicide; Yishan was transferred to Yarkand consultant minister.
translations.idiomatic: Saishiyaletai killed himself; Yishan became Yarkand consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以布彥泰赴肅州調度，命楊以增署陝甘總督，恆春署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guihai, because Buyantai went to Suzhou to direct operations, Yang Yizeng was made acting Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general and Hengchun acting Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Buyantai went to Suzhou; Yang Yizeng acted Shaanxi-Gansu and Hengchun Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以喀什噶爾卡外布魯特、安集延匪作亂，命布彥泰為定西將軍，奕山為參贊大臣，討之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, because Burut and Andijan bandits beyond the Kashgar passes had rebelled, Buyantai was made Pacification General of the West and Yishan consultant minister to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, frontier Burut and Andijan rebels brought Buyantai as western general and Yishan as consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 以善燾為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Shanyu was made Uliassutai consultant minister.
translations.idiomatic: Shanyu became Uliassutai consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 以吉明署葉爾羌參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Jiming was made acting Yarkand consultant minister.
translations.idiomatic: Jiming acted at Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，奕湘改杭州將軍，調奕興為盛京將軍，以英隆為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Yixiang was transferred to Hangzhou general; Yixing was transferred to Shengjing general; and Yinglong was made Suiyuan garrison general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yixiang went to Hangzhou, Yixing to Shengjing, and Yinglong to Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 以河南災廣，再撥內帑銀三十萬兩，並命戶部撥銀三十萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: Because the Henan disaster was widespread, another three hundred thousand taels from the inner treasury and three hundred thousand taels from the Board of Revenue were allocated for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's widening disaster drew another 600,000 taels from palace and revenue reserves.

sentences.zh: 丙子，安集延匪圍英吉沙爾城，命布彥泰駐肅州，遣兵討之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Andijan bandits besieged Yengisar city; Buyantai was stationed at Suzhou and troops were dispatched to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Andijan rebels besieged Yengisar; Buyantai at Suzhou sent troops against them.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑甘肅西寧縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given to Xining county, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Gansu's Xining county received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 緩徵山東樂安等六縣被水額賦，並永利等四場灶課。

translations.literal: Collection of quota levies was deferred for six flooded Shandong counties including Le'an, and stove tax was deferred for four salt fields including Yongli.
translations.idiomatic: Quota levies were deferred for Le'an and five other flooded Shandong counties and for stove tax at Yongli and three other salt fields.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑朔，日食。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day dingchou: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, dingchou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命文慶、張澧中赴河南查賑。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Wenqing and Zhang Lizhong were ordered to Henan to inspect relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Wenqing and Zhang Lizhong were sent to Henan for relief inspection.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，吉明等遣兵援喀什噶爾，擊安集延匪，大敗之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Jiming and others sent troops to aid Kashgar, attacked Andijan bandits, and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Jiming's relief force routed Andijan bandits near Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以法蘭西兵船入朝鮮，命耆英言於法使，令其退兵。

translations.literal: On day yisi, because French warships had entered Korea, Keying was ordered to tell the French envoy to withdraw his troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Keying was told to demand French withdrawal after warships entered Korea.

sentences.zh: 是月，給河南禹州等四十一州縣旱災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, drought ration grain was issued to forty-one prefectures and counties in Henan including Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yuzhou and forty other drought-stricken Henan districts received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸安州等三十六州縣水旱災雹災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for thirty-six Zhili prefectures and counties including Anzhou that suffered flood, drought, and hail.
translations.idiomatic: Quota taxes were remitted or deferred for Anzhou and thirty-five other Zhili districts hit by flood, drought, or hail.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，湖南新寧縣瑤人雷再浩等作亂，陸費瑔等捕討之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou: Yao rebels Lei Zaihao and others in Xinning county, Hunan, rebelled; Lu Fei'e and others were ordered to capture and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, xinyou, Lei Zaihao's Yao rebels rose in Hunan's Xinning and Lu Fei'e was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor inspected Jianrui Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Emperor reviewed the Jianrui Camp.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，奕山等剿安集延匪於葉爾羌之科科熱依瓦特，大敗之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Yishan and others routed Andijan bandits at Kekureyiwate in Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Yishan defeated Andijan bandits at Kekureyiwate in Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 庚午，又敗之於英吉沙爾。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, they routed them again at Yengisar.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, they beat the bandits again at Yengisar.

sentences.zh: 壬申，安集延匪遁走。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Andijan bandits fled.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Andijan bandits withdrew.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾辦事領隊大臣開明阿等褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Kashgar resident commander Kaiming'a and others were stripped of office and arrested for questioning.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiming'a and other Kashgar commanders were dismissed and arrested.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲緩安徽泗州等三十九州縣水旱災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: That month, new and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for thirty-nine Anhui prefectures and counties including Luzhou that suffered flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Luzhou and thirty-eight other flood- and drought-stricken Anhui districts had quota taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，調英隆為黑龍江將軍，成玉為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen: Yinglong was transferred to Heilongjiang general and Chengyu to Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiashen, Yinglong took Heilongjiang and Chengyu took Suiyuan City.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以張澧中為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Zhang Lizhong was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Zhang Lizhong became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，湖南新寧賊平。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Xinning rebels in Hunan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Hunan's Xinning rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚子，湖南道州匪竄廣西灌陽縣，命鄭祖琛剿捕之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Daozhou bandits in Hunan fled into Guanyang county, Guangxi; Zheng Zuchen was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Hunan's Daozhou bandits entered Guangxi's Guanyang and Zheng Zuchen was ordered to hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 是月，給山西絳州等十一州廳縣口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to eleven Shanxi prefectures, departments, and counties including Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiangzhou and ten other Shanxi districts received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸安州等三州縣、山西絳州等十一州廳縣、河南禹州等六十四州縣被災新舊正雜額賦。

translations.literal: New and old regular and miscellaneous quota levies were remitted or deferred for three Zhili prefectures and counties including Anzhou, eleven Shanxi prefectures, departments, and counties including Jiangzhou, and sixty-four Henan prefectures and counties including Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Regular and miscellaneous quotas were remitted or deferred across disaster-hit districts in Zhili, Shanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，湖南乾州廳苗匪作亂，命裕泰等剿捕之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu: Miao bandits in Qianzhou department, Hunan, rebelled; Yutai and others were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, wuwu, Qianzhou Miao rebels rose and Yutai was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，召耆英還，以徐廣縉署兩廣總督及欽差大臣，辦理通商。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Keying was recalled to the capital; Xu Guangjin was made acting Guangdong governor-general and imperial commissioner for commercial relations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Keying returned to Beijing and Xu Guangjin became acting Guangdong governor-general and trade commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，給河南祥符等十七縣水災口糧，並貸鄭州等倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, flood ration grain was issued to seventeen Henan counties including Xiangfu, and granary grain was loaned to Zhengzhou and others.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xiangfu and sixteen other flooded Henan counties received rations and Zhengzhou and others received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月丁丑，加潘世恩太傅，寶興太保，保昌、阿勒清阿、李振祜、成剛太子太保。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, spring, first month, day dingchou: Pan Shien was advanced to Grand Tutor, Baoxing to Grand Preceptor, and Baochang, Aleqing'a, Li Zhenhu, and Chenggang to Junior Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, month 1, dingchou, Pan Shien became grand tutor, Baoxing grand preceptor, and four others junior grand preceptors.

sentences.zh: 甲申，湖南乾州廳苗匪降，命裕泰分別懲辦，仍搜餘匪。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Qianzhou Miao bandits surrendered; Yutai was ordered to punish accordingly and still hunt remaining bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Qianzhou Miao rebels surrendered and Yutai was told to punish them and pursue remnants.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命廓爾喀使附朝鮮、暹羅使筵宴。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Nepalese envoy was ordered to join the banquet for the Korean and Siamese envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Nepalese envoy was seated with the Korean and Siamese envoys at court banquet.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，越南國王阮福巿卒，停本年例貢。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the king of Vietnam Nguyen Phuc Tho died; the annual tribute for that year was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Vietnam's Nguyen Phuc Tho died and that year's tribute was halted.

sentences.zh: 免喀什噶爾民、回各戶正雜逋賦。

translations.literal: Regular and miscellaneous overdue levies for Han and Hui households in Kashgar were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar's Han and Hui overdue taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，展賑直隸鹽山等五縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster relief was extended for five Zhili counties including Yanshan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yanshan and four other Zhili counties received extended relief.

sentences.zh: 給安徽鳳陽等三縣水旱災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued for flood and drought in three Anhui counties including Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyang and two other Anhui counties received flood and drought rations.

sentences.zh: 貸湖南安鄉縣、山西寧遠等四廳縣、甘肅皋蘭等七縣災民口糧籽種。

translations.literal: Ration grain and seed grain were loaned to disaster victims in Hunan's Anxiang county, four Shanxi departments and counties including Ningyuan, and seven Gansu counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster victims in Anxiang, Ningyuan and three other Shanxi units, and Gaolan and six other Gansu counties received ration and seed loans.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，吏部尚書恩桂卒，文慶罷軍機大臣，調為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi: Minister of Personnel En Gui died; Wenqing left the Grand Council and was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renzi, En Gui died; Wenqing left the Grand Council for the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以麟魁為禮部尚書，桂良改正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Lin Kui was made Minister of Rites; Gui Liang was made commandant of the Plain White Banner Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Kui took rites and Gui Liang became Plain White Banner Han Army commandant.

sentences.zh: 以惠豐代為熱河都統，以保昌為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Huifeng replaced him as Rehe commandant; Baochang became Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Huifeng became Rehe commandant and Baochang Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，江西長寧、崇義兩縣匪作亂，命吳文鎔剿捕之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, bandits in Changning and Chongyi counties, Jiangxi, rebelled; Wu Wenrong was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Jiangxi's Changning and Chongyi bandits rose and Wu Wenrong was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以謁陵命睿親王仁壽等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, for the tomb visit Prince Rui Renshou and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Prince Rui Renshou and others stayed in Beijing for the tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，雲南趙州匪作亂，命林則徐剿捕之。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuyin: Zhao Prefecture bandits in Yunnan rebelled; Lin Zexu was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, wuyin, Yunnan's Zhao Prefecture bandits rose and Lin Zexu was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 以奕山為伊犁參贊大臣，吉明為葉爾羌參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Yishan was made Ili assistant commissioner; Jiming Yarkand assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yishan became Ili assistant commissioner and Jiming Yarkand assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted one-third of quota levies in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted one-third of passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵，詣孝穆皇后、孝慎皇后、孝全皇后陵寢奠酒。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor visited Tai Tomb, Tai East Tomb, and Chang Tomb and offered wine at the mausolea of Empresses Xiaomu, Xiaoshen, and Xiaoquan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor worshipped at Tai, Tai East, and Chang tombs and made offerings at Xiaomu, Xiaoshen, and Xiaoquan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，裕誠遷荊州將軍，以雙德為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Yu Cheng was transferred to Jingzhou general and Shuangde was made Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Yu Cheng went to Jingzhou and Shuangde became Chahar commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西吉州等七州縣歉收倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for poor harvest in seven Shanxi prefectures and counties including Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jizhou and six other Shanxi districts received poor-harvest granary loans.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，雲南保山匪平。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuchen: Baoshan bandits in Yunnan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, wuchen, Yunnan's Baoshan bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 辛未，廣西灌陽、平樂、陽朔等縣匪平。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, bandits in Guangxi counties including Guanyang, Pingle, and Yangshuo were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, bandits in Guanyang, Pingle, Yangshuo, and other Guangxi counties were pacified.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯朔，以徐澤醇為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day guimao: Xu Zequan was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: At the sixth-month new moon, guimao, Xu Zequan became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命耆英留京管禮部，授徐廣縉兩廣總督、欽差大臣，辦理通商。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Keying was kept in the capital to oversee the Ministry of Rites; Xu Guangjin was given Guangdong governor-general and imperial commissioner posts for commercial relations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Keying stayed in Beijing over rites and Xu Guangjin took Guangdong governor-general and trade commissioner posts.

sentences.zh: 以葉名琛為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Ye Mingchen was made Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mingchen became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，調耆英管兵部。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Keying was transferred to oversee the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Keying was moved to oversee the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以傅繩勛為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Fu Shengxun was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Fu Shengxun became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，調吳文鎔為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Wu Wenrong was transferred to Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Wu Wenrong became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，加林則徐太子太保，賞花翎。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengyin: Lin Zexu was advanced to Junior Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, gengyin, Lin Zexu became junior grand preceptor and received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，河南巡撫鄂順安褫職，以潘鐸代之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingsi: Henan governor E Shun'an was stripped of office and Pan Duo replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, dingsi, E Shun'an lost Henan and Pan Duo replaced him.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，俄羅斯商船請在上海貿易，卻之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, a Russian merchant ship requested trade at Shanghai; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, a Russian merchant ship seeking Shanghai trade was refused.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，潘錫恩免，以楊以增為江南河道總督，陳士枚為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu: Pan Xi'en was dismissed; Yang Yizeng was made Jiangsu grain-transport governor-general and Chen Shimei Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, jiaxu, Pan Xi'en was dismissed; Yang Yizeng took Jiangsu grain transport and Chen Shimei Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 召成玉來京，以盛熏署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Chengyu was summoned to the capital; Sheng Xun acted as Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyu was called to Beijing and Sheng Xun acted as Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 賑江寧等三府水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given to three Jiangning prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Three Jiangning prefectures received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑湖北水災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Hubei flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Hubei flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，召喬用遷來京，以羅繞典署貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Qiao Yongqian was summoned to the capital; Luo Raodian acted as Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Qiao Yongqian was recalled and Luo Raodian acted as Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，給湖南武陵等四縣水災口糧屋費。

translations.literal: That month, flood ration grain and housing funds were issued to four Hunan counties including Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wuling and three other flooded Hunan counties received rations and housing funds.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，文華殿大學士寶興卒。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiayin: Grand Secretary Baoxing of the Wenhua Hall died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, jiayin, Wenhua Hall Grand Secretary Baoxing died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，修巴爾楚克城。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Barkul city was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Barkul city was repaired.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸通州等七州縣、安徽無為等十六州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given to seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou and sixteen Anhui prefectures and counties including Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Tongzhou and six other Zhili districts and Wuwei and fifteen other Anhui districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給安徽和州等十四州縣，湖南華容縣、岳州衛災民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued to fourteen Anhui prefectures and counties including Hezhou and to disaster victims in Huarong county and Yuezhou Guard, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhou and thirteen other Anhui districts and Huarong and Yuezhou Guard received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸湖南安鄉縣、澧州災民籽種。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned to disaster victims in Hunan's Anxiang county and Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Anxiang and Lizhou received disaster seed loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸通州等五十二州縣、湖北沔陽等三十九州縣衛、湖南澧州等九州縣、安徽泗州等二十四州縣被災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for fifty-two Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou, thirty-nine Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Mianyang, nine Hunan prefectures and counties including Lizhou, and twenty-four Anhui prefectures and counties including Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Quota taxes were remitted or deferred across Tongzhou and fifty-one other Zhili districts, Mianyang and thirty-eight other Hubei units, Lizhou and eight other Hunan districts, and Luzhou and twenty-three other Anhui districts.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，封故越南國王阮福巿子福時為越南國王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yihai: Nguyen Phuc Tho's son Phuc Thi was enfeoffed as king of Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, yihai, Phuc Thi was enfeoffed king of Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命耆英為大學士，管兵部。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Keying was made Grand Secretary overseeing the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Keying became grand secretary over war.

sentences.zh: 以琦善為協辦大學士，仍留四川總督任。

translations.literal: Qishan was made associate Grand Secretary while remaining Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan became associate grand secretary and kept Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 召瑞元來京，以慧成為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Ruiyuan was summoned to the capital; Huicheng was made Kobdo assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ruiyuan was recalled to Beijing and Huicheng became Kobdo assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 御史張鴻升請鑄大錢，下部議。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Hongsheng requested casting large cash coins; the matter was referred to the ministries for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongsheng urged large-cash coinage and the ministries were ordered to discuss it.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命定郡王載銓、侍郎季芝昌查辦直隸鹽務，大學士耆英、侍郎硃鳳標查辦山東鹽務。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Prince Ding Zaiquan and Vice Minister Ji Zhichang were ordered to investigate Zhili salt affairs; Grand Secretary Keying and Vice Minister Zhu Fengbiao to investigate Shandong salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Zaiquan and Ji Zhichang were sent to investigate Zhili salt and Keying and Zhu Fengbiao Shandong salt.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，授耆英文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Keying was appointed Wenyuan Pavilion Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Keying became Wenyuan Pavilion grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以托明阿為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Tuoming'a was made Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Tuoming'a became Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江西德化等二十縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, flood ration grain was issued to twenty Jiangxi counties including Dehua.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dehua and nineteen other flooded Jiangxi counties received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸湖南提標及常德等協營災區兵餉。

translations.literal: Troop pay was loaned to the Hunan provincial standard and Changde and other garrison camps in disaster zones.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan provincial standard and Changde and other garrisons in disaster zones received pay loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇泰州等七十七州廳縣衛、兩淮呂泗等二十場、江西德化等二十二縣、直隸安州等六州縣水災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for seventy-seven Jiangsu prefectures, departments, counties, and guards including Taizhou, twenty Liang-Huai salt fields including Lüsi, twenty-two Jiangxi counties including Dehua, and six Zhili prefectures and counties including Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Quota taxes were remitted or deferred across Taizhou and seventy-six other Jiangsu units, Lüsi and nineteen other salt fields, Dehua and twenty-one other Jiangxi counties, and Anzhou and five other Zhili districts.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingwu: the Emperor prayed for snow at the Dagao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, bingwu, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor again prayed for snow at the Dagao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor again prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上詣天壇祈雪。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Temple of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Temple of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以侍郎陳孚恩前署山東巡撫不收公費，賞一品頂戴，並御書扁額。

translations.literal: On day renxu, because Vice Minister Chen Fu'en had served as acting Shandong governor without accepting public stipends, he was granted a first-rank button and an imperial inscribed plaque.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Chen Fu'en was rewarded with a first-rank button and imperial plaque for refusing stipends as acting Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以倭什訥為吉林將軍，成剛為禮部尚書，柏葰為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Woshina was made Jilin general, Chenggang Minister of Rites, and Baijia Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Woshina took Jilin, Chenggang rites, and Baijia the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以張祥河為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zhang Xianghe was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Zhang Xianghe became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸通州等十四州縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in fourteen Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Tongzhou and thirteen other Zhili districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、越南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Vietnam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Vietnam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月癸未，以奕格為烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, day guiwei: Yige was made Uliasutai general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29, month 1, guiwei, Yige became Uliasutai general.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命耆英、季芝昌查閱浙江營伍及倉庫。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Keying and Ji Zhichang were ordered to inspect Zhejiang garrisons and storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Keying and Ji Zhichang were sent to inspect Zhejiang troops and storehouses.

sentences.zh: 是月，加賑安徽無為等十四州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: That month, supplementary flood relief was given to fourteen Anhui prefectures, departments, counties, and guards including Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wuwei and thirteen other Anhui districts received added flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給湖南澧州等六州縣、安徽和州等十三州縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: Flood ration grain was issued to six Hunan prefectures and counties including Lizhou and thirteen Anhui prefectures and counties including Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhou and five other Hunan districts and Hezhou and twelve other Anhui districts received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 貸江西南昌等十二縣、湖南澧州等六州縣水災籽種。

translations.literal: Flood seed grain was loaned to twelve Jiangxi counties including Nanchang and six Hunan prefectures and counties including Lizhou.
