translations.idiomatic: Nanchang and eleven other Jiangxi counties and Lizhou and five other Hunan districts received flood seed loans.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子朔，日食。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day gengzi: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the second-month new moon, gengzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命劉韻珂撫恤台灣北路水災震災。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Liu Yunke was ordered to comfort flood and earthquake victims in northern Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Liu Yunke was sent to comfort northern Taiwan's flood and earthquake victims.

sentences.zh: 丙午，諭李星沅辦江蘇賑務。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Li Xingyuan was instructed to handle Jiangsu relief affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Li Xingyuan was ordered to manage Jiangsu relief.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，穆彰阿、潘世恩、陳官俊免上書房總師傅。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Muzhang'a, Pan Shien, and Chen Guanjun were dismissed as chief tutors of the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Muzhang'a, Pan Shien, and Chen Guanjun left the Upper Study chief tutorship.

sentences.zh: 命祈俊藻、杜受田為上書房總師傅，受田仍授皇四子讀。

translations.literal: Qi Junzao and Du Shoutian were made chief tutors of the Upper Study; Shoutian still taught the fourth imperial son.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Junzao and Du Shoutian became Upper Study chief tutors; Shoutian still taught the fourth imperial son.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，四川中瞻對番工布朗結作亂，命琦善剿之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Bronjie of Zhonggandui Tibetan workers in Sichuan rebelled; Qishan was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Bronjie's Zhonggandui Tibetan workers rebelled in Sichuan and Qishan was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 以裕誠兼署四川總督。

translations.literal: Yu Cheng was also ordered to act as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Cheng was also ordered to act as Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江蘇災區京左等八營一季兵餉。

translations.literal: That month, one quarter's army pay was loaned to eight camps including Jingzuo in the Jiangsu disaster area.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jiangsu disaster camps including Jingzuo received a quarter's army pay on loan.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，徐廣縉等奏，兵民互相保衛，內河外海，現飭嚴防，英人進省城一事，萬不可行。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: Xu Guangjin and others memorialized that soldiers and people were protecting one another, inner rivers and outer seas were being strictly guarded, and English entry into the provincial capital was absolutely impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin day, Xu Guangjin reported tight coastal defense and insisted the English must not enter the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 諭嘉納之。

translations.literal: An edict praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised and approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，李星沅病免，以陸建瀛為兩江總督，調傅繩勛為江蘇巡撫，以費開綬為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renyin: Li Xingyuan was dismissed for illness; Lu Jianying was made Liang-Jiang governor-general; Fu Shengxun was transferred as Jiangsu governor; Fei Kaishou was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, renyin, Li Xingyuan left office for illness; Lu Jianying took Liang-Jiang, Fu Shengxun Jiangsu, and Fei Kaishou Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，陸建瀛等奏南漕毋庸改折，從之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Lu Jianying and others memorialized that southern grain transport need not be converted to cash payments; the Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Lu Jianying won assent to keep southern tribute grain unconverted.

sentences.zh: 丁未，徐廣縉奏英人罷議進城。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Xu Guangjin memorialized that the English had abandoned talks on entering the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Xu Guangjin reported the English had dropped demands to enter the city.

sentences.zh: 封徐廣縉子爵、葉名琛男爵，均一等世襲。

translations.literal: Xu Guangjin was enfeoffed as viscount and Ye Mingchen as baron, both with first-rank hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Guangjin became a hereditary viscount and Ye Mingchen a hereditary baron of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 諭嘉獎粵人深明大義。

translations.literal: An edict praised and rewarded the Cantonese for deeply understanding righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised Guangdong for grasping the larger duty.

sentences.zh: 閏四月辛未，以顏以燠署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day xinwei: Yan Yiyu was ordered to administer as Hedong Grand Canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on xinwei day, Yan Yiyu acted as Hedong canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，調趙炳言為湖南巡撫，以羅繞典為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhao Bingyan was transferred as Hunan governor and Luo Raodian as Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Zhao Bingyan took Hunan and Luo Raodian Hubei.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，琦善剿中瞻對番，敗之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Qishan suppressed the Zhongzhandui tribes and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Qishan defeated the Zhongzhandui tribes.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以德齡為葉爾羌參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Deling was made Yarkand resident commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Deling became Yarkand resident commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，移廣東澳門稅口於黃埔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi: the Guangdong Macao tax station was moved to Huangpu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yisi day, Macao customs moved to Huangpu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雲南騰越廳野夷作亂，林則徐討平之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, wild tribes in Tengyue subprefecture, Yunnan, rebelled; Lin Zexu quelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Yunnan Tengyue tribes rebelled and Lin Zexu suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 己未，山西巡撫王兆琛以受賕褫職逮問，以季芝昌為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Shanxi governor Wang Zhaochen was stripped of office and arrested for accepting bribes; Ji Zhichang was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Wang Zhaochen lost Shanxi for bribery and Ji Zhichang replaced him.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山東滕縣雹災倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for hail disaster in Teng county, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shandong's Teng county received hail-disaster granary loans.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，廣東陽山、英德等縣匪平。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: bandits in Yangshan and Yingde counties, Guangdong, were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Guangdong bandits in Yangshan and Yingde were pacified.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禮部尚書成剛卒。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Minister of Rites Cheng Gang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Minister of Rites Cheng Gang died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，調毓書為烏魯木齊都統，以惟勤為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Yushu was transferred as Urumchi general and Wei Qin as Rehe general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Yushu went to Urumchi and Wei Qin became Rehe general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，福建閩縣匪林仕等作亂，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon day bingchen: bandits led by Lin Shi and others in Min county, Fujian, rebelled; they were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on the new moon bingchen, Fujian Min county rebels under Lin Shi were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，協辦大學士、吏部尚書陳官俊卒，調賈楨為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Cooperating Grand Secretary and Minister of Personnel Chen Guanjun died; Jia Zhen was transferred as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Chen Guanjun died; Jia Zhen became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以孫瑞珍為禮部尚書，王廣廕為左都御史。

translations.literal: Sun Ruizhen was made Minister of Rites and Wang Guangyin Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ruizhen took Rites and Wang Guangyin the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 以馮德馨為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Feng Dexin was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Dexin became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命祁俊藻協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Qi Junzao was ordered to cooperate as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Qi Junzao was ordered to serve as cooperating grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命湖南布政使萬貢珍賑武陵等縣被水災民。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Hunan provincial treasurer Wan Gongzhen was ordered to relieve flood victims in Wuling and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Wan Gongzhen was sent to relieve flood victims in Wuling and other Hunan counties.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，王兆琛遣戍新疆。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Wang Zhaochen was sent into exile in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Wang Zhaochen was exiled to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 己未，林則徐病免，以程矞採為雲貴總督，張日晸為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Lin Zexu was dismissed for illness; Cheng Yucai was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Zhang Rizhao Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Lin Zexu left office for illness; Cheng Yucai took Yunnan-Guizhou and Zhang Rizhao Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 降侍郎戴熙三品頂戴休致。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Dai Xi was reduced to third-rank hat and granted retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Xi retired with a reduced third-rank hat.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江西德化等五縣、湖南澧州等九州縣衛水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations were given for flood in five counties including Dehua, Jiangxi, and nine prefectures and counties including Lizhou, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood rations went to five Jiangxi counties including Dehua and nine Hunan districts including Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇川沙等二十二廳縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for twenty-two subprefectures and counties including Chuansha, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu's twenty-two districts including Chuansha had new and old quotas remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，陸建瀛奏辦賑及水退情形。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: Lu Jianying memorialized on relief work and conditions after the waters receded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou day, Lu Jianying reported on relief and recession of the flood.

sentences.zh: 諭：「臣民之福，即朕之福。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The welfare of ministers and people is the Emperor's welfare.
translations.idiomatic: The court said: "The people's welfare is the Emperor's welfare.

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，召季芝昌來京，以龔裕署山西巡撫。

translations.literal: " On day bingxu, Ji Zhichang was summoned to the capital; Gong Yu acted as Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingxu day, Ji Zhichang was recalled and Gong Yu acted as Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，給奉天錦州旗民、江西鄱陽等九縣、湖南澧州等十州縣衛水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations were given to Jinzhou banner people in Fengtian, nine counties including Poyang in Jiangxi, and ten prefectures and counties including Lizhou in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood rations went to Fengtian Jinzhou bannermen, nine Jiangxi counties including Poyang, and ten Hunan districts including Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，布彥泰病免，以琦善署陝甘總督，裕誠署四川總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen: Buyantai was dismissed for illness; Qishan acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general and Yusheng acted as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen day, Buyantai left office; Qishan acted at Shaanxi-Gansu and Yusheng at Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，授顏以燠河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Yan Yiyu was appointed Hedong Grand Canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Yan Yiyu received the Hedong canal post.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命署吏部右侍郎季芝昌在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: On day wushen, acting Vice Minister of Personnel Ji Zhichang was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, acting personnel vice minister Ji Zhichang joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 己酉，授琦善陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Qishan was appointed Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Qishan received Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 以徐澤醇為四川總督，陳慶偕為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Xu Zechun was made Sichuan governor-general and Chen Qingxie Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zechun became Sichuan governor-general and Chen Qingxie Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，雲南保山界外小宇江等處野夷作亂，程矞采剿平之。

translations.literal: On day guichou, wild tribes beyond Baoshan, Yunnan, including Xiaoyujiang, rebelled; Cheng Yucai suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yunnan tribes beyond Baoshan rebelled and Cheng Yucai put them down.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命服闋尚書何汝霖仍在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Minister He Rulin, having completed mourning, was again ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, He Rulin, back from mourning, rejoined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 是月，給貴州桐梓縣水災口糧，並蠲緩額賦。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations were given for flood in Tongzi county, Guizhou, and quota levies were remitted or deferred.
translations.idiomatic: That month Guizhou's Tongzi received flood rations and tax relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，以故朝鮮國王李怳子昪襲爵，命瑞常、和色本往冊封。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengwu: because the former king of Korea, Li Huan's son Bian, succeeded to the title, Ruichang and Heseben were sent to invest him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on gengwu day, Ruichang and Heseben were sent to invest Korea's new king Bian.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大學士潘世恩請開缺，命免軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Grand Secretary Pan Shien asked to be relieved of duty and was removed from the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Pan Shien left office and left the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以賡福署熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Gengfu acted as Rehe general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Gengfu acted as Rehe general.

sentences.zh: 是月，給湖南澧州等七州縣、山西徐溝縣被災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations were given to seven prefectures and counties including Lizhou, Hunan, and Xugou county, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month seven Hunan districts including Lizhou and Shanxi's Xugou received famine rations.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸薊州等三十七州縣、浙江富陽等二十一縣、山西薩拉齊等三廳縣被災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for thirty-seven prefectures and counties including Jizhou, Zhili, twenty-one counties including Fuyang, Zhejiang, and three subprefectures and counties including Salaqi, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief covered thirty-seven Zhili districts, twenty-one Zhejiang counties, and three Shanxi units including Salaqi.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午朔，湖南新寧縣匪李沅發作亂，命馮德馨剿之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon day jiawu: bandits led by Li Yuanfa in Xinning county, Hunan, rebelled; Feng Dexin was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon jiawu, Hunan Xinning rebels under Li Yuanfa rose and Feng Dexin was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太傅、予告大學士阮元卒。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Grand Tutor and retired Grand Secretary Ruan Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Ruan Yuan, grand tutor and retired grand secretary, died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，調龔裕為湖北巡撫，以兆那蘇圖為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Gong Yu was transferred as Hubei governor and Zhaonasutu as Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Gong Yu took Hubei and Zhaonasutu Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，阿哥所火。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the A-ge residence caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the princes' quarters burned.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，台灣嘉義縣匪徒吳吮等作亂，捕誅之。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, bandits led by Wu Xun and others in Jiayi county, Taiwan, rebelled; they were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Taiwan Jiayi rebels under Wu Xun were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江西德化等十四縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in fourteen counties including Dehua, Jiangxi, was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month fourteen Jiangxi counties including Dehua received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給齊齊哈爾等六城旗民、浙江仁和等八場灶丁口糧。

translations.literal: Famine rations were given to banner people in six cities including Qiqihar and to saltern households in eight fields including Renhe, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqihar and five other cities' bannermen and eight Zhejiang salterns received famine rations.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇泰州等七十三州廳縣衛、江西德化等二十一縣被災新舊額賦，浙江海沙等十四場灶課。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for seventy-three prefectures, subprefectures, counties, and garrisons including Taizhou, Jiangsu, twenty-one counties including Dehua, Jiangxi, and saltern levies in fourteen fields including Haisha, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief covered seventy-three Jiangsu units, twenty-one Jiangxi counties, and fourteen Zhejiang salterns.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，湖南道州匪黃三等作亂，命裕泰剿之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengwu: bandits led by Huang San and others in Daozhou, Hunan, rebelled; Yutai was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu day, Daozhou rebels under Huang San rose and Yutai was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 以扎拉芬泰為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Zhalafentai was made Tarbagatai resident commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalafentai became Tarbagatai resident commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，皇太后不豫，上詣慈寧宮問安，自是每日如之。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Empress Dowager fell ill; the Emperor went to Cining Palace to inquire after her health, and did so daily thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the empress dowager fell ill and the Emperor began daily visits to Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，奉安大行皇太后梓宮於慈寧宮。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the coffin of the late empress dowager was placed in Cining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the dowager's coffin was installed at Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 上居倚廬，席地寢苫。

translations.literal: The Emperor dwelt in a mourning shed, sleeping on the ground on rush mats.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor mourned in a shed, sleeping on rush mats on the ground.

sentences.zh: 諸王大臣請還宮，不允。

translations.literal: Princes and ministers asked him to return to the palace; he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and ministers begged him to return to the palace; he refused.

sentences.zh: 甲申，移皇太后梓宮於綺春園迎暉殿。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the empress dowager's coffin was moved to Yinghui Hall in the Qichun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the coffin was moved to Yinghui Hall in Qichun Garden.

sentences.zh: 自是上居慎德堂苫次。

translations.literal: From then on the Emperor dwelt in mourning quarters at Shende Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Emperor kept mourning quarters at Shende Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，李振祜病免，以陳孚恩為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Li Zhenhu was dismissed for illness; Chen Fuen was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Li Zhenhu left office and Chen Fuen became minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，湖南新寧賊分竄廣西，鄭祖琛遣兵防剿。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Xinning rebels scattered into Guangxi; Zheng Zuchen sent troops to defend and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Xinning rebels fled into Guangxi and Zheng Zuchen sent troops against them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、越南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Vietnam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea, Ryukyu, and Vietnam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月甲午朔，日食。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, spring, first month, new moon day jiawu: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30, spring, month 1, new moon jiawu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以祁俊藻等查覆陝甘總督布彥泰清查關防不密，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, because Qi Junzao and others investigated and reported that Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Buyantai's seal inspection had been lax, the case was referred to the Boards for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Buyantai faced severe board review after Qi Junzao found lax seal control.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以王大臣再請停止親送大行皇太后梓宮，諭從之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, because princes and ministers again asked that the Emperor stop personally escorting the late empress dowager's coffin, an edict assented.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the court assented when princes again asked the Emperor not to escort the coffin in person.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上大行皇太后尊諡曰孝和恭慈康豫安成熙聖睿皇后。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the late empress dowager was given the honorific title Empress Xiaoyi, Respectful, Harmonious, Kind, Joyful, Secure, Accomplished, Radiant, Sagely, and Wise.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the late empress dowager received the posthumous title Empress Xiaoyi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上詣迎暉殿孝和睿皇后梓宮前行大祭禮。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor performed the great mourning rites before the coffin of Empress Xiaoyi at Yinghui Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor performed great mourning rites before the dowager's coffin at Yinghui Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上詣梓宮前行周月祭禮。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor performed the monthly mourning rites before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor performed the monthly mourning rites before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，尊孝和睿皇后陵曰昌西陵。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Empress Xiaoyi's mausoleum was titled Changxi Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the dowager's tomb was named Changxi Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上不豫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上疾大漸。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor's illness grew critical.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor's illness turned critical.

sentences.zh: 召宗人府宗令載銓，御前大臣載垣、端華、僧格林沁，軍機大臣穆彰阿、賽尚阿、何汝霖、陳孚恩、季芝昌，總管內務府大臣文慶公啟鐍匣，宣示御書「皇四子立為皇太子」。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Clan Zaiquan, Imperial Front Grandees Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and Sengge Rinchen, Grand Councillors Mujangga, Saishanga, He Rulin, Chen Fuen, and Ji Zhichang, and Chief Steward of the Imperial Household Weng Qing opened the sealed casket and proclaimed the imperial will: "The fourth imperial son is established as crown prince."
translations.idiomatic: Zaiquan, Zaiyuan, Duanhua, Sengge Rinchen, Mujangga, Saishanga, He Rulin, Chen Fuen, Ji Zhichang, and Weng Qing opened the sealed box and read: "Establish the fourth imperial son as crown prince."

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩於圓明園慎德堂苫次。

translations.literal: That day, the Emperor died in mourning quarters at Shende Hall in the Yuanming Garden.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Emperor died at Shende Hall in the Yuanming Garden.

sentences.zh: 硃諭「封皇六子奕訢為親王」。

translations.literal: A vermillion edict said: "Enfeoff the sixth imperial son Yixin as prince."
translations.idiomatic: A vermillion edict enfeoffed the sixth son Yixin as prince.

sentences.zh: 四月甲戌，上尊諡曰效天符運立中體正至文聖武智勇仁慈儉勤孝敏成皇帝，廟號宣宗。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiaxu: the late Emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor who accorded with Heaven and bore the mandate, established the central body, rectified the ultimate, was cultured and sagely, martial and wise, brave and benevolent, frugal and diligent, filial and keen, and accomplished; his temple name was Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, jiaxu, the late Emperor received his full posthumous title and the temple name Xuanzong.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年二月壬子，葬慕陵。

translations.literal: Xianfeng 2, second month, day renzi: burial at Mu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2, month 2, renzi, he was buried at Mu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 論曰：宣宗恭儉之德，寬仁之量，守成之令辟也。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Xuanzong's respectful frugality and generous magnanimity made him an accomplished keeper of the heritage.
translations.idiomatic: The annalists say Xuanzong was frugal and magnanimous—a true keeper of the throne.

sentences.zh: 遠人貿易，構釁興戎。

translations.literal: Distant peoples' trade provoked quarrels and raised armies.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign trade stirred conflict and war.

sentences.zh: 其視前代戎狄之患，蓋不侔矣。

translations.literal: Compared with the frontier troubles of former ages, they were hardly comparable.
translations.idiomatic: Beside earlier frontier troubles, these were in a different order.

sentences.zh: 當事大臣先之以操切，繼之以畏葸，遂遺宵旰之憂。

translations.literal: The ministers in charge were first harsh and exacting, then fearful and hesitant, and thus left the worry of sleepless nights.
translations.idiomatic: Leading ministers began harsh, then grew timid, leaving the ruler sleepless with care.

sentences.zh: 所謂有君而無臣，能將順而不能匡救。

translations.literal: As the saying goes, there was a ruler but no ministers—able to comply but unable to correct and rescue.
translations.idiomatic: So it was said: there was a ruler but no ministers—men who could flatter but not save the state.

sentences.zh: 國步之瀕，肇端於此。

translations.literal: The empire's verge of ruin began from this.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty's slide toward ruin began here.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，悕矣！

translations.literal: Alas, how remote!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, how far it has fallen!
